Title: Signing of Banxico-INEGI collaboration agreements
text: Remarks by the Governor of the Bank of Mexico, Dr. Agustin Guillermo Carstens Carstens, during the signing of the BANXICO-INEGI collaboration agreements aimed at guaranteeing and expediting the transfer of the measurement of price indices from the Bank of Mexico to INEGI. October 12, 2010 ? Mr. President of the National Institute of Statistics and Geography, Dr. Eduardo Sojo Garza-Aldape ? Madam Vice President of the Governing Board of the National Institute of Statistics and Geography, Rocio Ruiz Chavez ? Mr. Director General of National Accounts and Economic Statistics of INEGI, actuary Jose Arturo Blancas Espejo ? Mr. General Director of Economic Research of the Bank of Mexico, Dr. Manuel Ramos Francia ? Mr. Director of Systematization of Statistical Information and Services of the Bank of Mexico, Dr. Jose Antonio Murillo Garza ? Public servants of INEGI who accompany us ? Colleagues of the Bank of Mexico ? Friends of the media We have invited you to witness the signing of three interinstitutional agreements aimed at fully ensuring a successful transfer of the system for measuring 1 prices from the Bank of Mexico to the National Institute of Statistics and Geography. It is one of the final stages of a process of institutional transformation of the Mexican State that, I have no doubt, has left innumerable benefits to the current generations of Mexicans and that at the end, on July 15, 2011, with the full transfer to INEGI of the tasks of measuring the evolution of prices, with rigor and opportunity, and in accordance with methodologies of excellence, a decisive institutional arrangement for the future of Mexico will culminate. It is worth making a very brief historical review to highlight the importance of this process, foreseen since 1993 when the Federal Executive sent to the Congress of Union the initiative of decree by which articles 28, 71 and 123 of the Mexican Constitution were modified, to grant autonomy to the Central Bank and, in this way, institutionally guarantee that Mexicans would never again suffer the dire consequences of high and out-of-control inflation. In the explanatory statement of this initiative, the Executive described with great clarity all the havoc caused by high inflations, not only by vanishing the purchasing power of wages. 2 and of those who receive other fixed incomes, but canceling the possibilities of economic growth. In addition, it was recalled that high inflation rates inhibit and hinder saving, generate deep uncertainty in the planning of investments, punish production and innovation, make the efficient allocation of resources very difficult if not impossible and, in extreme cases, could eliminate even the use of the national currency, by completely eroding its functions of measurement and store of value. From this enumeration, the explanatory statement concluded: "if there is to be a permanent policy of combating inflationary forces, it is clear that it is desirable to separate the function of creating money from other tasks of the State, in which repeated demands to increase spending are continually faced." That and no other is the profound - crucial - reason that underpins the autonomy of our Central Bank. The valuable explanatory statement that I commented on, in a visionary way warned: "If the proposed constitutional reform is approved, it would not be appropriate for statistics on indices of 3 prices will continue to be borne by the central bank. Its production would be entrusted to the National Institute of Statistics, Geography and Informatics, a decentralized body of the federal public administration with technical autonomy, to carry it out with the objectivity and high quality that until now have characterized it. " That is why with this process of transferring the objective and punctual measurement of prices, we will be giving full culmination to the institutional modernization that gave autonomy to the Bank of Mexico on the first of April 1994. But if it was already clear, since then, the desirability of the autonomous Central Bank not being in charge of measuring inflation and, therefore, of measuring itself with respect to the fulfillment of its priority mandate, it soon also became clear that the merely technical autonomy that INEGI had at that time was insufficient to guarantee Mexico and all Mexicans that the measurement of price growth was fully safeguarded. of any possibility of self-interested bias, even if such a possibility seems remote. And it is that in the end, and even with the so-called technical autonomy that mentioned the explanatory statement, the INEGI remained for several more years an entity 4 government sectorized in the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit. It was not until March 2008 with the enactment of the Law on the National System of Statistics and Geography that INEGI acquired its full autonomy. Therefore, this law establishes the deadline to complete this transfer of the task of measuring prices from the Central Bank to the National Institute of Statistics and Geography, whose Governing Board is chaired by Dr. Eduardo Sojo. Although it took about 14 years for this transfer to take shape and term, during all that time the Governing Board of the Bank of Mexico has scrupulously taken care that the measurement of consumer and producer prices in all its stages continued to be perfected, systematizing it and taking all the quality controls that guarantee its objectivity and precision. Since 1927 when the newborn Bank of Mexico began to calculate the first price index, then referring only to the weekly quotation of 16 products in Mexico City, to date the Central Bank has carried out this task with the greatest care, with the best statistical techniques and the best information processing instruments available at all times. 5 But it has been especially from the autonomy of the Bank that this care has been taken to the extreme. Hence the credibility and respectability before society that the price indices prepared by the Bank of Mexico have earned over the years. Thus, for example, in the case of the National Consumer Price Index in 1994, the number of cities in which price quotations are raised was expanded to 46, covering all entities in the country with at least one city per entity, the basket of generic goods and services reached 313 and monthly quotations went from 140 to 170 thousand. Later, in July 2002, a further update of the INPC was made, keeping the number of cities of quotation in 46, expanding the number of generic concepts to 315, while the number of quotations increased to 235 thousand prices each month. With regard to the National Producer Price Index, which has been shown to be a very useful tool for anticipating inflationary pressures on consumer prices, and which has been calculated in the Bank since 1980, in 1996 the coverage of the INPP was extended to include all sectors of the economy. In January of that same year, the publication of the INPP began with the 1994 base and the services sector was incorporated. 6 The most recent INPP base change was published in February 2004 and the basis of comparison is December 2003. The number of specifications considered in the elaboration of the indicator is 29,500; the basket of goods and services consists of 600 generic concepts; the directory of Information Sources is made up of 4,200 establishments. A sample of the technical excellence achieved by the price indices that the Bank of Mexico has calculated and disseminated is the evaluation of them made a few months ago by a group of specialists chosen by the International Monetary Fund; a group that included the same fund experts as independent experts. In the report of the results of this review it is said, and I quote: "As far as the consumer price and producer price indices are concerned, there has been significant progress in the methodology as well as in the statistical techniques used, so that the quality control procedures that these price indices have can be considered of the first rank worldwide." I take this opportunity to give my widest recognition to the level of excellence that dozens of public servants have maintained over the years at the Bank of Mexico. 7 who have dedicated, many of them, most of their lives as well as the best of their talents and knowledge to the country having price measurements that meet all the requirements of objectivity, statistical rigor and opportunity. Measurements whose results, in terms of science and transparency of procedures, are unassailable and generate great confidence for economic agents and for all Mexicans. I now turn to a brief description of the content of each of the interinstitutional agreements that are being signed today: ? The first of the agreements aims to facilitate the advance transfer to INEGI of human capital specialized in the collection of information for price statistics, that is: quotes or surveyors. INEGI has agreed to hire such staff with positions of indefinite duration. ? The second of the agreements addresses the convenience of the Bank of Mexico delivering to INEGI the calculation systems it has developed for the preparation of both the National Consumer Price Index and the National Producer Price Index. In principle, the Bank of Mexico would provide technical support for such systems for up to six months 8 after INEGI is responsible for the publication of these indices. These first two agreements will be signed by the officials who head the respective areas in each institution. ? The third agreement will be signed by Dr. Sojo and me and formalizes that the Bank of Mexico will have unrestricted access to the methodology, databases, information and procedures used by INEGI to calculate price indices. This is due to the crucial importance that the Bank's Governing Board has real-time access to the price microdata bases of both indices for monetary policy decision-making, since such information allows the timely identification of possible inflationary pressures. Ladies and gentlemen: The importance of a punctual, objective and rigorous measurement of price developments for the fulfillment of the priority mandate of the Bank of Mexico, which is to ensure the stability of the purchasing power of the national currency, is obvious. It is also clear that the most desirable institutional arrangement is for such measurement to be carried out by a different State entity. 9 of the Central Bank itself, but equally autonomous from the government in its functioning and administration. The agreements that we will sign today are thus one more element not only to give fluidity to this transfer process, but to guarantee that both autonomous entities, INEGI and the Central Bank, have all the elements and tools to fulfill with excellence their respective tasks in service of all Mexicans. Thanks a lot. 10

Por ello, en dicha ley se establece el plazo para culminar esta transferencia de la tarea de medicin de los precios del Banco Central al Instituto Nacional de Estadstica y Geografa, cuya Junta de Gobierno preside el doctor Eduardo Sojo. Esto obedece a la importancia crucial que para la toma de decisiones de poltica monetaria, de la Junta de Gobierno del Banco, tiene el acceso en tiempo real a las bases de microdatos de precios de ambos ndices, ya que tal informacin permite la identificacin oportuna de posibles presiones inflacionarias. Seoras y seores: Salta a la vista la importancia de una medicin puntual, objetiva y rigurosa de la evolucin de los precios para el cumplimiento del mandato prioritario del Banco de Mxico, que es procurar la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda nacional. Title: Monetary policy in Mexico at the beginning of a complex year
text: "MONETARY POLICY IN MEXICO AT THE BEGINNING OF A COMPLEX YEAR". INTERVENTION OF MR. JAVIER GUZMaN CALAFELL, DEPUTY GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MEXICO, AT THE EGADE BUSINESS SCHOOL OF TECNOLoGICO DE MONTERREY. Mexico City, January 18, 2018.1 I am very pleased to have the opportunity to participate in this EGADE course kick-off event. Many years have passed since I had the honor of being part of the staff of teachers of this prestigious School. My thanks to the organizers for the invitation to share with you some reflections on monetary policy in Mexico at this very special juncture. The Mexican economy faces an external environment with mixed characteristics. On the one hand, the world economy continued to show a gradual improvement during 2017, which is expected to continue throughout this year. The most recent estimates put global economic growth in 2017 at 3.7 percent, the highest figure in the last 6 years. In addition, this cyclical rebound has been accompanied by a growing generalization among economies, both emerging and advanced. In this environment, a further strengthening, albeit moderate, of global economic activity is projected during 2018. Because of its importance for Mexico, it is worth noting that this trajectory has been accompanied by a rebound in both global trade and industrial production, and a recovery in commodity prices. 1 The opinions and views expressed in this document are the responsibility of the author and do not necessarily represent the institutional position of the Bank of Mexico or its Governing Board as a whole. 1 Premiums. In particular, there has been an upward trend in both industrial production and foreign trade in the United States, and an increase in oil prices. This set of factors has stimulated the growth of Mexican exports. On the other hand, the world economy faces various risks and challenges, some of which are already affecting the performance of certain economic variables in Mexico. These include uncertainty surrounding the conduct of monetary policy in some major economies. Although the persistence of low inflation readings in advanced countries has generated the expectation of gradual monetary normalization processes by their respective central banks, given the potential emergence of price pressures that could result from the sustained reduction in slack levels in their economies, surprises in this area cannot be ruled out. In the United States, this risk is accentuated by the recent approval of fiscal stimulus measures. Information derived from surveys of analysts and market instruments points to between two and three additional increases in the federal funds rate in 2018. However, this could follow a more pronounced trajectory given that the fiscal expansion will materialize in a context of indicators that, in general, suggest a situation of, or close to, full employment. To this should be added the potential challenges for investment in Mexico and other countries that could result from the recent tax cuts in the United States. 2 In terms of trade, the risk that, on the one hand, the United States and other countries adopt positions of greater protectionism that affect international flows of goods, services and factors of production has not been dissipated. Naturally, in the case of our country, the main concern stems from the final result of the renegotiation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA). At the same time, although less than until recently in the light of recent agreements, high uncertainty remains as to the UK's future economic and trade relationship with the European Union. To this can be added the challenges arising from geopolitical tensions in some regions, as well as from political difficulties and electoral processes in various countries. The materialization of these risks could have significant implications for international financial markets, with particularly marked consequences in emerging economies. While capital flows to these countries have continued to be driven to a large extent by an environment of low interest rates and global risk appetite, the possibility of abrupt changes in market sentiment in the face of surprises in the above areas or for other reasons should not be lost sight of. such as corrections resulting from a possible overvaluation of some riskier assets, or problems linked to vulnerabilities in major economies, such as China. The Mexican economy has adjusted in an orderly manner both to the challenges arising from this external environment and to others of an internal nature. The 3 Economic activity has continued to show a moderate expansion, albeit with a weakening trend. Investment has remained stagnant, affected both by the adjustment of public finances and by the uncertainty derived, among other factors, from the future economic relationship with the United States. In this way, the growth of the economy has been supported by private consumption and manufacturing exports, although with signs of slowdown in the first of these variables. On the supply side, industrial production shows a contraction as a result of weak oil production and construction. At the same time, the services sector maintains an upward trend, although with some loss of dynamism in recent months, partially explained by the effect of the September earthquakes. Under reconstruction efforts in response to recent natural disasters and the recovery of oil production, GDP growth should pick up during the fourth quarter of the year. All in all, the economy is expected to slow by around one percentage point during 2017. Economic activity is expected to continue to grow at a moderate pace during 2018, driven by a combination of demand and supply factors similar to that observed last year. In my opinion, this scenario faces various risks. The lack of certainty around the NAFTA negotiations, or an adverse outcome thereof, may affect the trajectory of investment. In addition, the possible uncertainty derived 4 This year's electoral process in Mexico could be reflected in the evolution of domestic demand. Externally, although the world economy shows a generally favorable trajectory, as already noted, outbreaks of nervousness in international financial markets cannot be ruled out as a result of the normalization of monetary policy in the United States, especially in the face of the approval of the fiscal package in that country, events of a geopolitical nature or other factors, that affect the performance of the Mexican economy. According to statistical estimates, the output gap is currently slightly negative, and is also projected to close at a gradual pace over the horizon of influence of monetary policy. Other variables also suggest that the Mexican economy is not currently facing significant demand pressures. These include the moderate level of the current account deficit of the balance of payments, which is estimated to have decreased from 2.1 percent of GDP in 2016 to 1.7 percent in 2017; the slowdown in total financing in the economy, whose growth in real terms slowed from close to 6 percent per year in 2016 to less than 2 percent in the first nine months of 2017; the contraction of the real wage bill throughout 2017 and the absence of significant wage pressures. However, taking into account the sharp decline in the degree of slack in the labour market, it will be important to continue to carefully assess the possibility of the emergence of risks on this front. In the case of inflation, we are seeing figures above what was anticipated until recently. In fact, the expected downward trajectory of inflation during the last months of 2017 did not materialize. This 5 Behavior is explained by the evolution of the underlying component and, more importantly, the non-underlying component. On the one hand, core inflation has been affected by a weaker-than-expected exchange rate of the peso against the dollar, cost increases stemming from higher energy prices, increases in the minimum wage, and baseline comparison effects on telecommunications prices, among other factors. In the case of non-core inflation, its trajectory has been determined particularly by pressures arising from the prices of LP gas, gasoline and various agricultural products. In this context, although a significant fall in inflation continues to be projected during 2018, the outlook for price developments during the year has deteriorated. Thus, although on a moderate scale, inflation expectations for the end of 2018 have been adjusted upwards. In the case of long-term ones, those based on surveys remain above the target, but stable around 3.5 percent. Regarding a scenario of convergence of inflation to the 3 percent target at the end of 2018, the balance of risks maintains an upward bias. It is likely that the peso's exchange rate will continue to show volatility during the coming months, as a result, among other factors, of the process of normalization of monetary policy in the United States, the fiscal reform in that country, the evolution of the NAFTA negotiations and this year's electoral process in Mexico. On the other hand, the projections of a sharp fall in non-core inflation in 2018, essential to reach the target at the end of the year, are subject to a high degree of uncertainty. It should also be noted that the spreads between nominal interest rates and 6 Real over government securities point to upside risks to inflation in the long run. During the last weeks, the exchange rate of the peso against the dollar has shown significant fluctuations, remaining at high levels. This behavior has been influenced by factors of both an internal and external nature, highlighting among them the changes in sentiment around the NAFTA negotiations, expectations about the normalization of monetary policy in the United States, the approval of the fiscal reform in that country, the perception of a more cautious attitude of the Bank of Mexico and the evolution of risk appetite in international financial markets. In a context of increased inflationary pressures and a balance of upside risks to inflation, the Governing Board of the Bank of Mexico decided in December 2017 to increase the target for the overnight interbank interest rate by 25 basis points, to a level of 7.25 percent. Thus, since December 2015 the monetary policy interest rate has increased by 425 basis points. At present, the ex ante real interest rate of monetary policy is at a level of 3.29 percent. Estimates for the benchmark long-term neutral interest rate place it in a range of 1.7 to 3.3 percent in real terms.2 While these calculations are subject to a high degree of uncertainty, this suggests that, being within the neutral rate estimation range, it is not possible to say that monetary policy 2 The policy rate is considered neutral when it is at levels consistent with economic activity close to its potential in an environment of stable inflation. 7 is having a restrictive effect on economic activity. In any case, it is clear that the costs for this of a late and/or insufficient response on the part of the Central Bank to inflationary pressures such as those we have seen in the last two years, would be much higher than those resulting from the effect of a timely and adequate tightening of monetary policy. It should be noted that, in addition to the impacts of exchange rate depreciation and various supply shocks on prices, banco de Mexico's shares have responded to the upward trend in interest rates in the United States. By virtue of the close relationship between the Mexican economy and the U.S. economy, the degree of our country's openness to foreign flows and the environment of uncertainty that we face, in the absence of at least equivalent monetary policy action in Mexico, a greater depreciation of the peso would surely have been observed and, by this means, additional pressures on inflation. As the stability of long-term inflation expectations shows, monetary policy measures have made it possible to avoid second-order effects of supply shocks on prices. At the same time, these actions have contributed to a flattening of the yield curve and substantially widening the interest rate differential with the United States along the curve. While significant demand pressures on prices are not expected throughout 2018, there is a risk that recent or future shocks will result in a deanchoring of long-term inflation expectations. In particular, as already noted, there is a possibility that the 8 the scenario facing the economy in the coming months implies a high volatility of the exchange rate, especially during the first half of the year. Likewise, the slowdown in the growth rate of the prices of various products that have affected non-core inflation could be slower than expected. Therefore, it may be necessary to raise the reference rate again in the near future. Of course, the Bank of Mexico must be prepared to take the appropriate actions, as soon as required. In my opinion, in this process the implementation of monetary policy should take careful account, on the one hand, of the high levels of inflation, the persistence of inflation and the risks it faces and, on the other, the phase of deceleration that the economy is going through, the expectation that there will be no demand pressures on prices during the period of influence of monetary policy. and the nature of the factors that are affecting inflation. In general terms, during the coming months monetary policy will have to continue to be adjusted as circumstances require, in such a way that the convergence of inflation to the target is achieved, at a pace that allows preserving the credibility of monetary policy and taking due account of the need for this process to involve the lowest possible cost for economic activity. It is worth emphasizing that under no circumstances should the credibility of the Central Bank be allowed to be weakened. 9
text_original: LA POLTICA MONETARIA EN MXICO AL INICIO DE UN AO COMPLEJO. INTERVENCIN DEL LIC. JAVIER GUZMN CALAFELL, SUBGOBERNADOR DEL BANCO DE MXICO, EN LA EGADE BUSINESS SCHOOL DEL TECNOLGICO DE MONTERREY. Ciudad de Mxico, 18 de enero de 2018.1 Me da mucho gusto tener la oportunidad de participar en este evento de inicio de cursos de la EGADE. Ya pasaron muchos aos desde que tuve el honor de formar parte de la planta de maestros de esta prestigiosa Escuela. Mi agradecimiento a los organizadores por la invitacin a compartir con ustedes algunas reflexiones sobre la poltica monetaria en Mxico en esta coyuntura tan especial. La economa mexicana enfrenta un entorno externo con caractersticas mixtas. Por una parte, la economa mundial sigui mostrando durante 2017 una mejora gradual, que se anticipa contine a lo largo de este ao. Los clculos ms recientes ubican el crecimiento econmico global en 2017 en 3.7 por ciento, la cifra ms alta de los ltimos 6 aos. Adems, este repunte cclico ha venido acompaado de una creciente generalizacin entre economas, tanto emergentes como avanzadas. En este entorno, se proyecta un nuevo fortalecimiento, aunque moderado, de la actividad econmica global durante 2018. Por su importancia para Mxico, merece destacarse que esta trayectoria ha venido acompaada de un repunte tanto del comercio como de la produccin industrial globales, y de una recuperacin de los precios de las materias 1 Las opiniones y puntos de vista expresados en este documento son responsabilidad del autor y no necesariamente representan la postura institucional del Banco de Mxico o de su Junta de Gobierno en conjunto. 1 primas. En particular, se ha venido observando una tendencia alcista tanto de la produccin industrial como del comercio exterior en Estados Unidos, y un aumento de los precios del petrleo. Este conjunto de factores ha estimulado el crecimiento de las exportaciones mexicanas. Por otra parte, la economa mundial enfrenta diversos riesgos y retos, algunos de los cuales ya estn incidiendo en el desempeo de ciertas variables econmicas en Mxico. Entre estos, cabe sealar la incertidumbre en torno a la conduccin de la poltica monetaria en algunas de las principales economas. Si bien la persistencia de bajas lecturas de inflacin en los pases avanzados ha generado la expectativa de procesos de normalizacin monetaria graduales por parte de sus respectivos bancos centrales, ante el potencial surgimiento de presiones sobre los precios que podran derivarse de la sostenida reduccin de los niveles de holgura en sus economas, no se pueden descartar sorpresas en este mbito. En Estados Unidos, este riesgo se ve acentuado por la reciente aprobacin de medidas de estmulo fiscal. La informacin derivada de encuestas entre analistas y de instrumentos de mercado apuntan a entre dos y tres incrementos adicionales de la tasa de fondos federales en 2018. No obstante, esta podra seguir una trayectoria ms pronunciada dado que la expansin fiscal se materializar en un contexto de indicadores que, en general, sugieren una situacin de, o cercana al, pleno empleo. A lo anterior cabe agregar los potenciales retos para la inversin en Mxico y otros pases que podran resultar de los recientes recortes impositivos en Estados Unidos. 2 En materia comercial, no se ha disipado el riesgo de que, por una parte, Estados Unidos y otros pases adopten posturas de mayor proteccionismo que afecten los flujos internacionales de bienes, servicios y factores de produccin. Naturalmente, en el caso de nuestro pas la principal preocupacin se deriva del resultado final de la renegociacin del Tratado de Libre Comercio de Amrica del Norte (TLCAN). Al mismo tiempo, aunque menor que hasta hace poco a la luz de los acuerdos recientes, persiste una elevada incertidumbre en cuanto a la relacin econmica y comercial futura del Reino Unido con la Unin Europea. A lo anterior cabe agregar los desafos derivados de las tensiones geopolticas en algunas regiones, as como de las dificultades de ndole poltica y procesos electorales en diversos pases. La materializacin de estos riesgos podra tener implicaciones de consideracin para los mercados financieros internacionales, con consecuencias especialmente marcadas en las economas emergentes. Si bien los flujos de capital hacia estos pases han seguido siendo impulsados en buena medida por un entorno de bajas tasas de inters y apetito por riesgo a nivel global, no se debe perder de vista la posibilidad de cambios abruptos en el sentir de los mercados ante sorpresas en los mbitos mencionados o por otros motivos, tales como correcciones derivadas de una posible valuacin excesiva de algunos activos de mayor riesgo, o problemas vinculados a vulnerabilidades en economas importantes, como la china. La economa mexicana se ha ajustado de manera ordenada tanto a los retos derivados de este entorno externo como a otros de naturaleza interna. La 3 actividad econmica ha continuado mostrando una expansin moderada, aunque con una tendencia de debilitamiento. La inversin se ha mantenido estancada, afectada tanto por el ajuste de las finanzas pblicas como por la incertidumbre derivada, entre otros factores, de la futura relacin econmica con Estados Unidos. De esta forma, el crecimiento de la economa ha sido apuntalado por el consumo privado y las exportaciones manufactureras, aunque con indicios de desaceleracin en la primera de estas variables. Por el lado de la oferta, la produccin industrial muestra una contraccin como resultado de la debilidad de la produccin de petrleo y la construccin. Al mismo tiempo, el sector servicios mantiene una tendencia al alza, si bien con cierta prdida de dinamismo en meses recientes, explicada parcialmente por el efecto de los sismos de septiembre. En virtud de los esfuerzos de reconstruccin en respuesta a los recientes desastres naturales y de la recuperacin de la produccin de petrleo, el crecimiento del PIB debera repuntar durante el cuarto trimestre del ao. Con todo, se anticipa que la economa registre una desaceleracin de alrededor de un punto porcentual durante 2017. Es de esperarse que la actividad econmica contine creciendo a un ritmo moderado durante 2018, impulsada por una combinacin de factores de demanda y oferta similar a la observada el ao pasado. En mi opinin, este escenario enfrenta diversos riesgos. La falta de certeza en torno a las negociaciones del TLCAN, o un resultado adverso de las mismas, pueden incidir sobre la trayectoria de la inversin. Adems, la posible incertidumbre derivada 4 del proceso electoral de este ao en Mxico podra reflejarse en la evolucin de la demanda interna. En lo externo, si bien la economa mundial muestra una trayectoria en general favorable, como ya se seal no se pueden descartar brotes de nerviosismo en los mercados financieros internacionales como resultado de la normalizacin de la poltica monetaria en Estados Unidos, especialmente ante la aprobacin del paquete fiscal en ese pas, eventos de naturaleza geopoltica u otros factores, que afecten el desempeo de la economa mexicana. Segn las estimaciones estadsticas, en la actualidad la brecha del producto es ligeramente negativa, proyectndose adems su cierre a un ritmo gradual en el horizonte de influencia de la poltica monetaria. Otras variables sugieren tambin que la economa mexicana no enfrenta en este momento presiones significativas de demanda. Entre estas, cabe sealar el moderado nivel del dficit en la cuenta corriente de la balanza de pagos, que se estima disminuy de 2.1 por ciento del PIB en 2016 a 1.7 por ciento en 2017; la desaceleracin del financiamiento total en la economa, cuyo crecimiento en trminos reales se redujo de cifras cercanas a 6 por ciento anual en 2016 a menos de 2 por ciento en los primeros nueve meses de 2017; la contraccin de la masa salarial real a lo largo de 2017 y la ausencia de presiones salariales de consideracin. Ahora bien, tomando en cuenta la pronunciada disminucin del grado de holgura en el mercado laboral, ser importante seguir evaluando cuidadosamente la posibilidad del surgimiento de riesgos en este frente. En el caso de la inflacin, estamos observando cifras por encima de lo anticipado hasta hace poco. De hecho, la esperada trayectoria descendente de la inflacin durante los ltimos meses de 2017 no se materializ. Este 5 comportamiento se explica por la evolucin del componente subyacente y, de manera ms importante, del no subyacente. Por una parte, la inflacin subyacente se ha visto afectada por un tipo de cambio del peso frente al dlar ms dbil de lo previsto, aumentos de costos derivados de los mayores precios de los energticos, los incrementos del salario mnimo y efectos de base de comparacin en los precios de las telecomunicaciones, entre otros factores. En el caso de la inflacin no subyacente, su trayectoria ha sido determinada particularmente por las presiones derivadas de los precios del gas LP, la gasolina y diversos productos agropecuarios. En este contexto, si bien contina proyectndose una cada importante de la inflacin durante 2018, el panorama para la evolucin de los precios durante el ao se ha deteriorado. As, aunque en una magnitud moderada, las expectativas de inflacin para el cierre de 2018 se han ajustado al alza. En el caso de las de largo plazo, aquellas basadas en encuestas se mantienen por encima de la meta, pero estables alrededor de 3.5 por ciento. Respecto a un escenario de convergencia de la inflacin al objetivo de 3 por ciento a finales de 2018, el balance de riesgos mantiene un sesgo al alza. Es probable que el tipo de cambio del peso contine mostrando volatilidad durante los prximos meses, como resultado, entre otros factores, del proceso de normalizacin de la poltica monetaria en Estados Unidos, la reforma fiscal en ese pas, la evolucin de las negociaciones del TLCAN y el proceso electoral de este ao en Mxico. Por otra parte, las proyecciones de una fuerte cada de la inflacin no subyacente en 2018, indispensable para alcanzar la meta al cierre del ao, estn sujetas a un elevado grado de incertidumbre. Cabe sealar, asimismo, que los diferenciales entre las tasas de inters nominales y 6 reales sobre valores gubernamentales apuntan a riesgos al alza para la inflacin en el largo plazo. Durante las ltimas semanas, el tipo de cambio del peso frente al dlar ha mostrado fluctuaciones importantes, mantenindose en niveles elevados. En dicho comportamiento han influido factores de naturaleza tanto interna como externa, destacando entre ellos los cambios de sentimiento en torno a las negociaciones del TLCAN, las expectativas sobre la normalizacin de la poltica monetaria en Estados Unidos, la aprobacin de la reforma fiscal en ese pas, la percepcin de una actitud ms cautelosa del Banco de Mxico y la evolucin del apetito por riesgo en los mercados financieros internacionales. En un contexto de mayores presiones inflacionarias y un balance de riesgos al alza para la inflacin, la Junta de Gobierno del Banco de Mxico decidi en diciembre de 2017 aumentar el objetivo para la tasa de inters interbancaria a un da en 25 puntos base, a un nivel de 7.25 por ciento. De esta forma, desde diciembre de 2015 la tasa de inters de poltica monetaria se ha incrementado en 425 puntos base. En la actualidad, la tasa de inters real ex ante de poltica monetaria registra un nivel de 3.29 por ciento. Las estimaciones para la tasa de inters neutral de referencia en el largo plazo ubican a esta en un rango de 1.7 a 3.3 por ciento en trminos reales.2 Si bien estos clculos estn sujetos a un elevado grado de incertidumbre, lo anterior sugiere que, al ubicarse dentro del rango de estimacin de la tasa neutral, no es posible afirmar que la poltica monetaria 2 La tasa de poltica monetaria se considera neutral cuando se encuentra en niveles congruentes con una actividad econmica cercana a su potencial en un entorno de inflacin estable. 7 est teniendo un efecto restrictivo en la actividad econmica. En todo caso, es evidente que los costos para esta de una respuesta tarda y/o insuficiente de parte del Banco Central a presiones inflacionarias como las que hemos visto en los dos ltimos aos, seran muy superiores a los resultantes del efecto de un apretamiento oportuno y adecuado de la poltica monetaria. Cabe sealar que, adems de los impactos de la depreciacin del tipo de cambio y diversos choques de oferta sobre los precios, las acciones del Banco de Mxico han respondido a la tendencia al alza de las tasas de inters en Estados Unidos. En virtud de la estrecha relacin de la economa mexicana con la estadounidense, el grado de apertura de nuestro pas a flujos del exterior y el entorno de incertidumbre que enfrentamos, en ausencia de una accin cuando menos equivalente de la poltica monetaria en Mxico, seguramente se habra observado una depreciacin mayor del peso y, por este medio, presiones adicionales sobre la inflacin. Como lo muestra la estabilidad de las expectativas de inflacin de largo plazo, las medidas de poltica monetaria han permitido evitar efectos de segundo orden de los choques de oferta sobre los precios. Al mismo tiempo, estas acciones han contribuido a un aplanamiento de la curva de rendimientos y a ampliar de manera sustancial el diferencial de tasas de inters con Estados Unidos a lo largo de la curva. No obstante que no es de esperar que se presenten presiones significativas de demanda sobre los precios a lo largo de 2018, existe el riesgo de que choques recientes o futuros den lugar a un desanclaje de las expectativas de inflacin de largo plazo. En particular, como ya se seal, existe la posibilidad de que el 8 escenario que enfrente la economa en los prximos meses implique una volatilidad elevada del tipo de cambio, especialmente durante el primer semestre del ao. Asimismo, el descenso del ritmo de crecimiento de las cotizaciones de diversos productos que han afectado a la inflacin no subyacente pudiera ser ms lento de lo previsto. Por tanto, puede ser necesario aumentar nuevamente la tasa de referencia en el futuro cercano. Por supuesto, el Banco de Mxico debe estar preparado para tomar las acciones que correspondan, tan pronto como se requiera. En mi opinin, en este proceso la implementacin de la poltica monetaria deber tomar cuidadosamente en cuenta, por una parte, los elevados niveles de inflacin, la persistencia de esta y los riesgos a los que se hace frente y, por la otra, la fase de desaceleracin por la que est atravesando la economa, la expectativa de que no se presentarn presiones de demanda sobre los precios durante el periodo de influencia de la poltica monetaria y la naturaleza de los factores que estn afectando la inflacin. En trminos generales, durante los prximos meses la poltica monetaria tendr que seguirse ajustando conforme las circunstancias lo requieran, de tal forma que se logre la convergencia de la inflacin a la meta, a un ritmo que permita preservar la credibilidad de la poltica monetaria y tomar debidamente en consideracin la necesidad de que este proceso implique el menor costo posible para la actividad econmica. No est por dems enfatizar que bajo ninguna circunstancia debe permitirse que se vea debilitada la credibilidad del Banco Central. 9

Title: Award ceremony of the fifth edition of the BANXICO Challenge Contest
text: Remarks by Mr. Alejandro Diaz de Leon, Governor of the Bank of Mexico, during the Award Ceremony of the Fifth Edition of the "BANXICO Challenge" Contest. Mexico City, June 11, 2020 Introduction Good afternoon. I hope that all of you and your families will be well and in good spirits in this contingency. I am pleased to participate in this virtual ceremony to recognize the winners of the fifth edition of the "BANXICO Challenge" contest. This event seeks to strengthen the links of the Bank of Mexico with institutions and students of higher education; disseminate the importance and social benefits implied by its objectives and promote the interest of future professionals in the crucial issues of monetary policy and central banking. Usually, the Interactive Museum of Economics (MIDE) offers us its hospitality for the closing of this contest. Today, in these extraordinary conditions, mide accompanies us with the dissemination of its new proposal: the "MIDE Digital" where, as we could see, the physical MIDE is complemented with content on new platforms, which allows to extend its extraordinary task of economic and financial dissemination to wider audiences. Congratulations to all the team that has been working for a long time on this project that, today, is a reality. 1 The current environment A few months ago, when the call for this contest was made, the social and economic panorama that we live today was difficult to conceive. The current circumstance is the product of a health problem, external to the economic cycle, which, however, has had immediate and intense repercussions on the global economy. The COVID-19 pandemic and the social distancing measures adopted around the world to limit its spread have considerably affected the economy, dislocating value chains and paralyzing much of the productive activity. Likewise, this environment has led to a deterioration in global financial conditions and a recomposition of investment portfolios towards lower risk assets, generating a large decrease in the holding of assets in emerging economies. The challenges to the conduct of monetary policy arising from the pandemic include both the sudden contraction in economic activity and those associated with the financial shock. 2 Faced with this situation, the Bank of Mexico has adopted a comprehensive vision. On the one hand, there have been cuts in the interest rate. On the other hand, various measures to provide liquidity were announced; promote the orderly functioning of financial markets and strengthen credit channels. In short, unprecedented actions have been taken to contribute to a better adjustment of the national economy to a sudden and unexpected global change. The crucial role of the Bank of Mexico In this circumstance, more than ever, it becomes important to reflect on the enormous relevance of the functions of a central bank and its ability to react quickly to new challenges. Central banks provide their societies with fiat money and must ensure that it adequately fulfills its three essential functions, which are to act as: (i) unit of account; ii) generally accepted means of payment and iii) reliable store of value. Experience and theory show that having an independent central bank permanently oriented to seek the stability of 3 prices provide greater certainty to companies about the functions and proper use of fiat money and, at the same time, allows the bank to react with greater flexibility and consistency to unprecedented situations. Therefore, the global trend since the end of the last century is for central banks to have autonomy. In our country, the Bank of Mexico obtained its autonomy just over 25 years ago and was given the priority objective of ensuring the stability of the purchasing power of the national currency. It was also assigned two interrelated objectives, to promote the healthy development of the financial system and the proper functioning of the payment system. Price stability provides certainty to the citizen about the purchasing value of their resources and allows a society to allocate its resources more efficiently. The healthy development of the financial system allows citizens to sustainably have better savings, investment and financing options, which contribute to deploying their talent and initiative. A good functioning of payment systems allows all kinds of economic and financial transactions to be carried out effectively. 4 Thus, the Bank of Mexico provides fundamental public goods, which must be complemented by other indispensable public goods, such as: (i) solid foundations in education and health that level opportunities; (ii) public policies that promote competition and long-term investment. The harmonious provision of this set of public goods makes it possible to achieve both basic objectives of social justice and economic efficiency, improving the possibilities of sustainable development of a nation. The importance of innovation and academic linkage Dear contestants: While the essential functions of central banking and its objectives remain the same, the external environment and the challenges they face are constantly evolving. On the one hand, there are unexpected events of high impact, such as the current pandemic, which modify the economic outlook in the short term and that require the adoption of unprecedented measures to be able to face them. On the other hand, there are long-term technological, demographic, political and environmental trends that are gradually and persistently transforming the structure of economies and societies. 5 This permanent change, whether gradual or sudden, requires developing new knowledge and adapting the conceptual schemes and tools we have. It is easier to respond to unforeseen events when there are robust and pragmatic data pools and approaches on which we can continuously improve our understanding of the economy and base our decision-making on it. Hence the importance of this contest, which allows us to link the work of the Bank of Mexico, which this year celebrates 95 years of its foundation, with the academic and professional concerns of many of the most outstanding higher education students in our country. The "BANXICO Challenge" contest has a well-earned prestige and a growing convening power. This year, 446 teams were registered and 338 trials were received, equivalent to a total of 1,944 participants among students and faculty advisors. The "BANXICO Challenge" allows an extended exercise of reflection, fresh and rigorous, on the dilemmas that arise in the decision-making of monetary policy and central banking. Today, our country faces an unprecedented challenge; to cope with it, it has the reserves of intelligence, imagination and character of its young students. For the Bank of Mexico, the organization of this contest, in the current contingency environment, has been more 6 demanding, but much more satisfying and rewarding, to verify the copious participation and the high quality of the works received. I congratulate all participants widely for their effort and enthusiasm, especially in these days of adversity. I also congratulate the winners of such a close competition. Thank you all for your professionalism, seriousness and talent. Remember that the ultimate goal of knowledge is to transform and, with your dedication and enthusiasm, I am sure that you will contribute to our having a better country. Thanks a lot. 7
text_original: Palabras del Lic. Alejandro Daz de Len, Gobernador del Banco de Mxico, durante la ceremonia de Premiacin de la Quinta Edicin del Concurso Reto BANXICO. Ciudad de Mxico, 11 de junio de 2020 Introduccin Muy buenas tardes. Espero que todos ustedes y sus familias se encuentren bien y con buen nimo en esta contingencia. Me da gusto participar en esta ceremonia virtual para reconocer a los ganadores de la quinta edicin del concurso Reto BANXICO. Este certamen busca estrechar los vnculos del Banco de Mxico con las instituciones y los estudiantes de educacin superior; difundir la importancia y beneficios sociales que implican sus objetivos y promover el inters de los futuros profesionistas en los temas cruciales de poltica monetaria y banca central. Usualmente, el Museo Interactivo de Economa (MIDE) nos ofrece su hospitalidad para el cierre de este concurso. Hoy, en estas condiciones extraordinarias, el MIDE nos acompaa con la divulgacin de su nueva propuesta: el MIDE Digital donde, cmo pudimos ver, se complementa al MIDE fsico con contenidos en nuevas plataformas, lo que permite extender su extraordinaria tarea de divulgacin econmica y financiera a pblicos ms amplios. Felicidades a todo el equipo que ha venido trabajando por mucho tiempo en este proyecto que, hoy, es una realidad. 1 El entorno actual Hace unos meses, cuando se realiz la convocatoria de este concurso, el panorama social y econmico que hoy vivimos era difcilmente concebible. La actual circunstancia es producto de un problema sanitario, externo al ciclo econmico, que, sin embargo, ha tenido repercusiones inmediatas e intensas en la economa global. La pandemia del COVID-19 y las medidas de distanciamiento social adoptadas en todo el mundo para limitar su propagacin han afectado considerablemente la economa, dislocando las cadenas de valor y paralizando buena parte de la actividad productiva. Igualmente, este entorno ha conducido a un deterioro en las condiciones financieras globales y a una recomposicin de los portafolios de inversin hacia activos de menor riesgo, generando una gran disminucin en la tenencia de activos de economas emergentes. Los retos para la conduccin de la poltica monetaria derivados de la pandemia incluyen tanto la sbita contraccin en la actividad econmica, como los asociados al choque financiero. 2 Ante esta situacin, el Banco de Mxico ha adoptado una visin integral. Por un lado, se han realizado recortes en la tasa de inters. Por otro lado, se dieron a conocer diversas medidas para proveer liquidez; promover el funcionamiento ordenado de los mercados financieros y fortalecer los canales de crdito. En suma, se han emprendido acciones inditas para contribuir a un mejor ajuste de la economa nacional a un cambio global sbito e inesperado. La funcin crucial del Banco de Mxico En esta circunstancia, ms que nunca, se vuelve importante reflexionar sobre la enorme relevancia de las funciones de un banco central y su capacidad de reaccionar rpidamente ante nuevos desafos. Los bancos centrales proveen a sus sociedades de dinero fiduciario y deben procurar que ste cumpla adecuadamente sus tres funciones esenciales que son fungir como: i) unidad de cuenta; ii) medio de pago generalmente aceptado y iii) depsito de valor confiable. La experiencia y la teora demuestran que contar con un banco central independiente y orientado permanentemente a buscar la estabilidad de 3 precios brinda mayor certidumbre a las sociedades sobre las funciones y el uso adecuado del dinero fiduciario y, a la vez, le permite al banco reaccionar con mayor flexibilidad y consistencia ante situaciones inditas. Por eso, la tendencia global desde finales del siglo pasado es que los bancos centrales cuenten con autonoma. En nuestro pas, el Banco de Mxico obtuvo su autonoma hace poco ms de 25 aos y se le brindo el objetivo prioritario de procurar la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda nacional. Tambin se le asignaron dos objetivos interrelacionados, promover el sano desarrollo del sistema financiero y el buen funcionamiento del sistema de pagos. La estabilidad de precios brinda certeza al ciudadano sobre el valor adquisitivo de sus recursos y permite a una sociedad asignar de manera ms eficiente sus recursos. El sano desarrollo del sistema financiero permite al ciudadano disponer sosteniblemente de mejores opciones de ahorro, inversin y financiamiento, que contribuyan a desplegar su talento e iniciativa. Un buen funcionamiento de los sistemas de pagos permite realizar eficazmente todo tipo de transacciones econmicas y financieras. 4 As, el Banco de Mxico, provee bienes pblicos fundamentales, los cuales deben complementarse con otros bienes pblicos indispensables, como: i) bases slidas en materia de educacin y salud que nivelen oportunidades y ii) polticas pblicas que promuevan la competencia y la inversin de largo plazo. La provisin armnica de este conjunto de bienes pblicos permite alcanzar tanto objetivos bsicos de justicia social como de eficiencia econmica, mejorando las posibilidades de desarrollo sostenible de una nacin. La importancia de la innovacin y vinculacin acadmica Estimados concursantes: Si bien las funciones esenciales de la banca central y sus objetivos siguen siendo los mismos, el entorno externo y los retos que enfrentan estn en constante evolucin. Por un lado, hay eventos inesperados de alto impacto, como la actual pandemia, que modifican el panorama econmico en el corto plazo y que requieren la adopcin de medidas inditas para poder enfrentarles. Por otro lado, hay tendencias tecnolgicas, demogrficas, polticas y de medio ambiente a largo plazo que transforman, de manera paulatina y persistente, la estructura de las economas y las sociedades. 5 Este cambio permanente, ya sea gradual o repentino, requiere desarrollar nuevos conocimientos y adaptar los esquemas conceptuales y las herramientas con que contamos. Es ms fcil responder a los imprevistos cuando se dispone de acervos de datos y enfoques slidos y pragmticos sobre los que podemos mejorar continuamente nuestra comprensin de la economa y basar en ello nuestra toma de decisiones. De ah la importancia de este concurso, que nos permite enlazar la labor del Banco de Mxico, que este ao celebra 95 aos de su fundacin, con las inquietudes acadmicas y profesionales de muchos de los estudiantes de educacin superior ms destacados de nuestro pas. El concurso Reto BANXICO tiene un bien ganado prestigio y un creciente poder de convocatoria. Este ao, se registraron 446 equipos y se recibieron 338 ensayos, lo que equivale a un total de 1,944 participantes entre estudiantes y profesores asesores. El Reto BANXICO permite realizar un extendido ejercicio de reflexin, fresco y riguroso, sobre las disyuntivas que se presentan en la toma de decisiones de poltica monetaria y de banca central. Title: Inauguration of the new permanent hall
text: Remarks by the Governor of the Bank of Mexico, Agustin Carstens, during the inauguration of the new permanent room "Sustainable Development: Economy, Society and Nature", at the Interactive Museum of Economics. November 22, 2011 Eng. Ignacio Deschamps Gonzalez, President, Technical Committee of the Interactive Museum of Economics (MIDE) Eng. Luis Pena Kegel, General Director of HSBC Mexico Dr. Jose Sarukhan Kermez, National Coordinator, of the National Commission for the Knowledge and Use of Biodiversity (CONABIO) Dr. Manuel Sanchez Gonzalez, Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mexico Lic. Silvia Singer Sochet, General Director, of the Interactive Museum of Economics Good night For the Bank of Mexico and for me it is particularly gratifying to inaugurate this new permanent room on sustainable development in the Interactive Museum of Economy. When in 2002 the Governing Board of the Bank of Mexico conceived and approved the establishment of this museum, it did so with the idea of creating a cultural and educational space that 1 harmoniously integrate the foundations of economic science with all aspects of human life. And precisely the notion of sustainable, sustainable or permanent development (the three denominations are usually used in Spanish, depending on the country in question) aspires to consolidate this harmonious integration. The definition of sustainable development disseminated in 2004 by the United Nations Commission for Development and the Environment is both simple and substantive: "Sustainable development is that which meets the needs of present generations without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs". This means seeking the harmonious integration of economic, social and ecological environments. In other words, it seeks that the creation of wealth or added value that we carry out today is maintained throughout the year. 2 of time, respecting the natural environment and laying the foundations for an increasingly equitable development between people and between nations, in which no one is excluded from the benefits of economic growth and in which, at the same time as material wealth grows, art and culture also flourish in all their diversity. This is not something utopian, but feasible and desirable. Nor is it about hindering economic growth or the generation of opportunities and jobs that in countries like Mexico we need so much. On the contrary, it is about promoting development with intelligence and with a long-term vision. A simple example of the importance of sustainable development is in the consideration of the global costs, present and future, caused by the use of fossil energy, such as oil and its derivatives. Today we know that the indiscriminate use of this type of 3 Fuels generate a deterioration in the environment that we need to remedy now, on pain of questioning the life and well-being of future generations. In terms of economy it is an opportunity cost. Not acting now to rationalize the use of such energy and mitigate the alterations they cause in the environment will be much more costly than acting decisively today. In fact, it is a highly recommended public investment for all governments, for all companies, for all families. Not only that. To the surprise of some and even in the midst of an economic, fiscal and financial crisis such as the one that most of the most developed economies are experiencing today, there are numerous companies in these countries that have increased their investments in sustainable development. For example, 44% of the world's 300 largest global companies say they have substantially increased their 4 investments in "green strategies" and sustainability since the global crisis of 2008. This growing importance that companies themselves, not just governments, are giving to sustainable development is logical: many companies have found that with high oil prices even relatively small investments aimed at using fossil fuels more efficiently save a lot of money and guarantee future supplies with greater slack. At the same time that awareness grows among companies and society about the decisive importance of caring for the environment and preserving a harmonious environment, science and technology are also advancing, so that it will be less and less expensive to take advantage of so-called renewable energies, such as solar or wind. Large mining companies, for example, operating in hard-to-reach locations, find it highly profitable to invest. 5 in the self-generation of renewable energies that, in the long run, will not only be less onerous than fossil energies, but from now on and forever guarantee them a less uncertain and vulnerable energy supply than they would have if they depended only on oil and its derivatives. The same is being done by numerous companies in the world to rationalize and reduce the use of other non-renewable resources such as paper or water. They are investments and savings that will undoubtedly make our planet more habitable. In the exhibitions of this new permanent room of the MIDE the public will find numerous examples of the immense value of any effort aimed at respecting and preserving the environment. It should come as no surprise that several successful global companies have increased their market value by engaging seriously, and with specific and verifiable actions, in this effort. Thus, the growth of the 6 In business, the growth of national economies is fully compatible with the care of the environment, even more: every day it will be worth more, before society and in the markets, that "green bond" that is behind a serious commitment to sustainable development. In conclusion, I would like to share with you a reflection on the similarity of the concept of sustainable development with what is the priority objective of the Bank of Mexico: to ensure the stability of the purchasing power of the currency. Both are permanent tasks, with a long time horizon, they are not conjunctural or ephemeral tasks. Both sustainable development and a monetary policy focused on price stability are responsible for laying the foundations so that we can grow more rapidly. The two tasks, taking care of the environment and taking care of the permanence of the value of our currency, seek to generate confidence in the 7 future and intelligently protect ourselves against contingencies. We want to grow, yes, and we want to grow at a faster pace, but with secure foundations, in a harmonious way and taking care of the house and the wealth that we owe to future generations. Thanks a lot. 8
text_original: Palabras del Gobernador del Banco de Mxico, Agustn Carstens, durante la inauguracin de la nueva sala permanente Desarrollo Sustentable: Economa, Sociedad y Naturaleza, en el Museo Interactivo de Economa. 22 de noviembre de 2011 Ing. Ignacio Deschamps Gonzlez, Presidente, Comit Tcnico del Museo Interactivo de Economa (MIDE) Ing. Luis Pea Kegel, Director General de HSBC Mxico Dr. Jos Sarukhn Kermez, Coordinador Nacional, de la Comisin Nacional para el Conocimiento y Uso de la Biodiversidad (CONABIO) Dr. Manuel Sanchez Gonzlez, Subgobernador del Banco de Mxico Lic. Silvia Singer Sochet, Directora General, del Museo Interactivo de Economa Buenas noches Para el Banco de Mxico y para m es particularmente grato inaugurar esta nueva sala permanente sobre desarrollo sustentable en el Museo Interactivo de Economa. Cuando en el ao 2002 la Junta de Gobierno del Banco de Mxico concibi y aprob el establecimiento de este museo lo hizo con la idea de crear un espacio cultural y educativo que 1 integrase armoniosamente los fundamentos de la ciencia econmica con todos los aspectos de la vida humana. Y precisamente la nocin de desarrollo sustentable, sostenible o permanente (las tres denominaciones suelen emplearse en castellano, segn el pas de que se trate) aspira a consolidar esa integracin armoniosa. La definicin de desarrollo sustentable que en 2004 difundi la Comisin para el Desarrollo y el Medio Ambiente de las Naciones Unidas es, a la vez, sencilla y sustanciosa: Desarrollo sustentable es aqul que satisface las necesidades de las generaciones presentes sin comprometer la capacidad de las futuras generaciones para dar satisfaccin a sus propias necesidades. Esto supone buscar la integracin armoniosa de los entornos econmico, social y ecolgico. En otras palabras, busca que la creacin de riqueza o de valor agregado que realicemos hoy se mantenga a lo largo 2 del tiempo, respetando el entorno natural y estableciendo las bases para que sea un desarrollo cada vez ms equitativo entre personas y entre naciones, en el que nadie quede excluido de los beneficios del crecimiento econmico y en el que, a la par que crece la riqueza material, tambin florezcan el arte y la cultura en toda su diversidad. Por el contrario, se trata de impulsar el desarrollo con inteligencia y con visin de largo plazo. Un ejemplo sencillo de la importancia del desarrollo sustentable lo tenemos en la consideracin de los costos globales, presentes y futuros, que ocasiona el uso de los energticos de origen fsil, como el petrleo y sus derivados. Hoy sabemos que el uso indiscriminado de este tipo de 3 combustibles genera un deterioro en el ambiente al cual necesitamos ponerle remedio ya, so pena de poner en entredicho la vida y el bienestar de las generaciones futuras. En trminos de economa se trata de un costo de oportunidad. No actuar ahora para racionalizar el uso de tales energticos y mitigar las alteraciones que ocasionan en el ambiente ser mucho ms costoso que actuar hoy con decisin. De hecho, se trata de una muy recomendable inversin pblica para todos los gobiernos, para todas las empresas, para todas las familias. No slo eso. Para sorpresa de algunos y an en medio de una crisis econmica, fiscal y financiera como la que hoy viven la mayora de las economas ms desarrolladas, son numerosas las empresas en esos pases que han incrementado sus inversiones en desarrollo sustentable. Por ejemplo, 44% de las 300 empresas globales ms grandes del mundo dicen que han aumentado sustancialmente sus 4 inversiones en estrategias verdes y en sustentabilidad a partir la crisis global de 2008. Esta importancia creciente que las mismas empresas, no slo los gobiernos, estn dando al desarrollo sustentable es lgica: muchas empresas han descubierto que con altos precios del petrleo incluso inversiones relativamente pequeas destinadas a usar los combustibles fsiles con mayor eficiencia suponen ahorrar mucho dinero y garantizar suministros futuros con mayor holgura. A la vez que crece la conciencia entre las empresas y la sociedad sobre la decisiva importancia del cuidado del ambiente y de preservar un entorno armonioso, tambin avanzan la ciencia y la tecnologa, de forma que cada vez ser menos costoso el aprovechamiento de las llamadas energas renovables, como la solar o la elica. Grandes empresas mineras, por ejemplo, que operan en lugares de difcil acceso, encuentran que es altamente rentable invertir 5 en la autogeneracin de energas renovables que, a la larga, no slo sern menos onerosas que las energas fsiles, sino que desde ahora y para siempre les garantizan un suministro energtico menos incierto y vulnerable que el que tendran si dependiesen slo del petrleo y sus derivados. Otro tanto estn haciendo numerosas empresas en el mundo para racionalizar y disminuir el uso de otros recursos no renovables como el papel o el agua. Son inversiones y ahorros que indudablemente harn nuestro planeta ms habitable. En las exposiciones de esta nueva sala permanente del MIDE el pblico encontrar numerosos ejemplos del inmenso valor que tiene cualquier esfuerzo destinado a respetar y preservar el ambiente. No debe sorprendernos que varias empresas globales exitosas hayan incrementado su valor de mercado al comprometerse seriamente, y con acciones especficas y verificables, en este esfuerzo. As pues, el crecimiento de los 6 negocios, el crecimiento de las economas nacionales es plenamente compatible con el cuidado del ambiente, ms an: cada da valdr ms, ante la sociedad y en los mercados, ese bono verde que est detrs de un serio compromiso con el desarrollo sustentable. Para terminar deseara compartir con ustedes una reflexin acerca de la similitud que guarda el concepto de desarrollo sustentable con el que es el objetivo prioritario del Banco de Mxico: procurar la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda. Ambas son tareas permanentes, con un horizonte de tiempo largo, no son labores coyunturales o efmeras. Ambas, el desarrollo sustentable y una poltica monetaria centrada en la estabilidad de precios, se responsabilizan de poner los cimientos para que podamos crecer ms aceleradamente. Las dos tareas, cuidar el entorno y cuidar la permanencia del valor de nuestra moneda, buscan generar confianza en el 7 futuro y protegernos inteligentemente frente a las contingencias. Queremos crecer, s, y queremos crecer a un ritmo ms acelerado, pero con bases seguras, de forma armoniosa y cuidando la casa y la riqueza que les debemos a las futuras generaciones. Title: Christmas traditions in the world
text: Words of Mtra. Irene Espinosa Cantellano, Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mexico, on the occasion of the presentation of the Recital "Christmas Traditions in the World" Mexico City, November 29, 2018 ? Dear officials and representatives of governmental, private and international institutions, ? Dear colleagues of the Bank of Mexico, ? Ladies and gentlemen, Good evening. Background It is a great pleasure for me to participate in the year-end cultural event of the Bank of Mexico, above all, because today an important cycle closes, as this is the last event organized by the Directorate of Information Coordination, whose name recently changed to "Directorate of Security and Organization of Information". The vocation of cultural diffusion and artistic promotion of the Bank of Mexico is the result of a long process, which began with the creation of the institution itself in 1925, when it received exclusively the power to create currency. Indeed, the minting of metal parts and the issue of banknotes requires the preservation and dissemination of the numismatic heritage, the nature of which is inherently artistic and cultural. Over time, this vocation has been developed to better meet new assignments and adapt to new realities, such as serving as a trustee of renowned Mexican museums, creating the first interactive museum of economics - in whose enclosure we are today - and promoting discussion on issues relevant to the Bank's activities. through the presentation of books with great academic or historical value. With today's cultural event, the Bank of Mexico celebrates twelve years of carrying it out. Since its inception, the purpose has been to foster culture and strengthen the Bank's ties with academic and governmental institutions, as well as with international organizations and diplomatic representations, among others. They have addressed various themes and some of their traditional artistic manifestations. The themes that have been exposed in this long period have been associated, mainly, with the history and culture of different nations with which Mexico has had, in addition to economic ties, cultural and artistic ties for decades. In this way, part of the cultural and historical wealth of Russia, Austria, Poland, Italy, Japan and Cyprus - in addition to that of our own country - has paraded through these events, through exhibitions of artistic objects, as well as musical samples and melodic recitals. On the recital of Christmas traditions in the world For this last occasion we have chosen music, as an artistic manifestation, and as a theme, Christmas traditions. The choice of theme is due not only to the time of year in which we find ourselves but also to the universal meaning of these traditions around the family. For its part, the selection of music as an artistic manifestation obeys its naturalness to transmit feelings, regardless of the nationality, language, time and culture of the people who listen to it. As Victor Hugo would say: "Music expresses what cannot be said and what is impossible to remain silent about."1 The recital that brings us together tonight is based on a selection of Christmas carols and musical pieces that are traditional in various parts of the world, including very diverse countries such as Mexico, Argentina, Spain, Italy, Germany, Ukraine, France, Austria and the United Kingdom. 1 Quote from the work "Les Miserables" by Victor Hugo. New Year's Eve Message In the context of this recital that we are about to enjoy, I want to take the opportunity to share my admiration for the ethical and professional values of the staff of the Bank of Mexico, which I have been able to appreciate in the time I have been in this great institution. These values are the basis of your excellence and strength, and I have no doubt that you will help us to successfully face the challenges that the country presents at this time. I can only wish you and your families a happy holiday, as well as success in your personal and professional projects for the coming year and invite you to enjoy this recital. Thank you very much and good evening.
