We have identified several policy anchors essential for the development of the new financial ecosystems (traditional and new stakeholders): 1) same-risk/same-regulation; 2) interoperability and network neutrality; 3) fostering competition and avoiding mergers and partnerships among dominant firms; 4) ensuring business continuity with large foreign providers; 1 The opinions and views expressed in this document are the sole responsibility of the author and do not necessarily represent the institutional position of the Banco de Mexico or of its Governing Board. 1 5) global coordination to address jurisdictional gaps; 6) client protection; and, 7) cybersecurity.  Let me highlight the risks and challenges that this process entail in a consumer perspective: 1. Building on a same-risk/same-regulation approach, which applies at the institution level, we should strive for a sameinformation/same protection approach, at the customer level. This implies that it should not matter which provider is serving the enduser (financial or non-financial). 2. New technologies allow for the collection and processing of vast amounts of transactional information both on current financial service users and potential users. Such information may enable financial service providers to develop better priced financial products and better suited for the customers needs, without misusing it or inducing behavioral biases. 3. To take advantage of innovation, sharing customers information between financial services providers. Financial regulators should make sure that the rules and standards for data sharing, level the playing field between providers. In this context, the standards set 2 for the development of Application Programming Interfaces (API) is central to take advantage of these developments. 4. Another challenge is how to include everybody, swiftly, as data on new users becomes available. A result of the covid-19 pandemic is that it has forced certain population segments to embrace new technologies, including e-commerce and overall digital transactions. For example, in Mexico, from the last quarter of 2019, before the pandemic hit, to the first quarter of 2021, the number of bank accounts linked to a cellphone increased from about 41 million to about 53 million, a 28 percent increase. 5. When customers give their authorization to sharing transactional data, they may find it challenging to understand what they are actually consenting to. Information disclosure approaches should set a pro-consumer threshold that takes stock of the behavioral biases they are exposed to. For instance, instead of requiring customers to read the fine-print in pages-long contracts, providers could be shown a few practical examples of the expected used of their data under different choices (even a video). Moreover, when end-users give their consent to providers for the use their 3 information, they should not face all-or-nothing options, but should face a menu of alternatives that empower their decision-making. 4

Title: Mexico and the generation of certainty in the economy and financial markets
text: Mexico and the generation of certainty in the economy and financial markets Remarks by the Governor of the Bank of Mexico, Dr. Agustin Carstens, at the opening of the 2011 Securities Market Forum. October 3, 2011  Mr. President of the Republic, Mr. Felipe Calderon Hinojosa  Mr. Secretary of Finance and Public Credit, Dr. Jose Antonio Meade Kuribrena  Mr. President of the Mexican Stock Exchange, Dr. Luis Tellez Kuenzler  Mr. President of the Mexican Association of Stock Exchange Intermediaries, Mr. Jose Mendez Fabre  Mr. President of the National Banking and Securities Commission, Dr. Guillermo Babatz Torres  Distinguished representatives of stock exchange and banking intermediaries  Ladies and gentlemen, Since the global crisis that erupted in 2008 investors in international financial markets 1 have increased their risk aversion. What has also changed in the last three years, and more markedly in recent times, is their perception of uncertainty, as unusual and unexpected events have happened in the economies of the most advanced countries in the world. Undoubtedly, the sovereign debt crisis in several European countries stands out, along with the pollution that this has caused to the financial system of that Continent, added to the great fiscal dilemmas that fiscal problems that the United States faces. Thus, three years after the start of the crisis, uncertainty remains, particularly with regard to the future of the economy of Europe and the United States. Not in vain at the last meeting of the International Monetary Fund held a few days ago, many Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors agreed to demand clear and immediate responses from the 2 Authorities of the advanced countries that are at the epicenter of the current financial crisis to the serious problems of over-indebtedness of families, banks and governments, as well as a clearer strategy of adjustment to their clearly committed fiscal balance sheets. There is no doubt that the first step on the long road to a recovery of the growth rate of the world economy, in a sustained and stable manner, must be the restoration of confidence, the generation of basic certainties by the leaders of the advanced economies, in harmonious collaboration with the International Monetary Fund, which has failed to materialize the role of leadership in these difficult times that many expected of him. On the other hand, a fact that distinguishes Mexico is that in recent years, and especially during the government of President Felipe Calderon, a constant in the field of 3 Economic policy has been the insistence on generating certainty. A responsible fiscal policy has been sustained, against all odds; a well-regulated and supervised banking system has been maintained, extraordinarily sound and solvent compared to the banking system of many other countries. In turn, the Central Bank has fully exercised its autonomy without departing from the constitutional mandate that orders it to pursue price stability. A comparison that is most illustrative of the progress we have made in Mexico in terms of financial stabilization, and that reflects the responsibility of the fiscal policy and monetary policy that we have followed, is what we can make between the weighted average term of government debt in Mexico and that of the United States. 4 In 1994, the weighted average term of government debt in pesos in Mexico was 0.63 years (230 days). That same year, 1994, the weighted average term of government debt in the United States was 5.08 years (about 1,854 days). Today, in Mexico, the weighted average term of government debt in pesos is 7.4 years (2,674 days) while the weighted average term of U.S. government debt is 5.2 years (1,898 days). This means that in Mexico we have not only extended that term more than eleven times from 1994 to date, but we have outsold the government debt of the United States, in those same terms of term, by more than two years. This comparison certainly reflects the confidence that investors are giving the government of Mexico in terms of macroeconomic management, to the extent that they are willing to entrust their money to it for an even longer term than 5 the term in which they entrust their money to the U.S. government. It is precisely with the same commitment to generate and guarantee certainty that has been done in the specific area of national financial markets. A set of reforms have been made to its regulatory framework that have led to its accelerated development. 1. In the foreign exchange market. The peso has become one of the few currencies of emerging countries that operates continuously 24 hours a day, which gives it great liquidity.  Today the Mexican peso occupies the 13th place among the most traded currencies in the world, which places us, within the emerging countries, only below Korea and Singapore. 6  Bid-sell spreads in interbank markets are comparable to those seen in the world's major currencies: dollar, yen, euro or pound sterling.  Most foreign exchange transactions are carried out today through electronic platforms, ensuring greater transparency in the price formation process and in the execution capacity.  The decisive factor behind all these advances has been the free floating of weight since the end of 1994. The sporadic interventions of the Bank of Mexico in the foreign exchange market have generally occurred under predefined rules, transparent and known in advance by all participants. In addition, our interventions have been made fundamentally with one objective in mind: to guarantee the orderly functioning of the market, trying to avoid generating situations of illiquidity that lead to a 7 excessive volatility in the price of the national currency. This implies that for many years the country's financial authorities have stopped intervening in the foreign exchange market by pursuing a specific level of the exchange rate. Our thesis has been that the only way to guarantee an adequate and stable level of exchange rate parity is to keep the fundamentals of our economy healthy. Certainly there may be temporary deviations of the price of the national currency from its fair value, as has happened recently as a result of the great turbulence in the external markets, but rest assured that this price in the medium term is strongly anchored at lower levels than the current ones due to the strong economic fundamentals that we have. 8 2. In the government stock market. The Federal Government has been able to create and develop a government securities market with terms of up to 30 years both in nominal fixed rate and in real rate through the UDIS.  Of course, this is a product of the responsible fiscal policy that I mentioned and that has not only contributed to low inflation, but has made it possible to extend the terms of the debt in a very orderly manner, thanks to a predictable and disciplined debt placement program followed by the Ministry of Finance.  The placement of these securities through auctions has been key to having fully transparent discovery and price formation processes. In turn, the syndicated placements of the recent issues have contributed to increasing liquidity giving another element of certainty to the markets. 9  The figure of market trainers has been consolidated and allows to give more liquidity and depth to the secondary market, as well as to have the important distribution network of the main credit institutions towards local and foreign investors. 3. In the derivatives market. The development of the foreign exchange market and the creation of a liquid and long-term yield curve in government securities has allowed, in turn, the growth of a liquid and efficient derivative instruments market, which has as underlying precisely the exchange rate and interest rates.  This development has been more pronounced in the interbank derivatives market. However, recently the futures in Mexder related to the exchange rate and interest rates have also shown significant growth. In this regard, the recent alliance between Mexder and the Chicago Merchantile Exchange should 10 further underpin the development of our publicly traded derivatives market by bringing a significant base of foreign investors to it. There is a clear regulatory challenge that was acquired by signing up to the G20 commitments for a new derivatives regulation. By the end of 2012 we will have to have:  The standardization of derivatives that are susceptible to standardization that are currently traded in interbank markets.  Electronic platforms suitable for concluding operations; this is an issue on which Mexico has already made remarkable progress.  Settlement of transactions through a central counterparty, and  A repository of information of all the operations that are carried out. 11 The challenge of these changes will be to comply with the new guidelines without losing the flexibility that derivatives operations have come to have in the interbank or over-the-counter markets. --- 0 --To conclude, I would like to make a final reflection, returning to the theme of the beginning of my speech. During these years of president Calderon's administration, we have focused on maintaining and increasing confidence in the macroeconomic sphere. This certainty, as we know, is a necessary, but not sufficient, condition for ensuring sustained and accelerated economic growth. But stability gives us the foundations to undertake without further delay the indispensable structural reforms that we require to grow at rates that are much higher than the current ones and steadily. 12 This imperative becomes more urgent than ever today with the prospect that the economies of the United States and Europe, which generate more than 45% of global GDP, will live through difficult times and will have, at best, very low growth for the coming years, which will result in less momentum for the national economy. It is precisely in order to compensate for this lack of external momentum in the future that the need for structural reforms has become extremely urgent. We simply cannot continue to afford inaction. Thanks a lot. 13
text_original: Mxico y la generacin de certidumbre en la economa y en los mercados financieros Palabras del Gobernador del Banco de Mxico, doctor Agustn Carstens, en la inauguracin del Foro del Mercado de Valores 2011. 3 de octubre de 2011  Seor Presidente de la Repblica, licenciado Felipe Caldern Hinojosa  Seor Secretario de Hacienda y Crdito Pblico, doctor Jos Antonio Meade Kuribrea  Seor Presidente de la Bolsa Mexicana de Valores, doctor Luis Tllez Kuenzler  Seor Presidente de la Asociacin Mexicana de Intermediarios Burstiles, licenciado Jos Mndez Fabre  Seor Presidente de la Comisin Nacional de Bancaria y de Valores, doctor Guillermo Babatz Torres  Distinguidos representantes de intermediarios burstiles y bancarios  Seoras y seores: A partir de la crisis global que estall en 2008 los inversionistas en los mercados financieros internacionales 1 han incrementado su aversin al riesgo. Lo que tambin ha cambiado en los ltimos tres aos, y ms marcadamente a ltimas fechas, es su percepcin de incertidumbre, en la medida que eventos inslitos e inesperados han sucedido en las economas de los pases ms avanzados del mundo. Sin duda destaca la crisis de deuda soberana en varios pases europeos, junto con la contaminacin que esto ha causado al sistema financiero de dicho Continente, adicionado a los grandes dilemas fiscales que problemas fiscales que enfrenta Estados Unidos. As pues, a tres aos de distancia del inicio de la crisis, la incertidumbre contina, en particular respecto del futuro de la economa de Europa y de los Estados Unidos. No en vano en la ltima reunin del Fondo Monetario Internacional celebrada hace unos cuantos das, muchos Ministros de Finanzas y Gobernadores de Bancos Centrales coincidimos en demandar respuestas claras e inmediatas por parte de las 2 autoridades de los pases avanzados que se encuentran en el epicentro de la presente crisis financiera a los graves problemas de sobreendeudamiento de familias, bancos y gobiernos, as como una ms clara estrategia de ajuste a sus balances fiscales claramente comprometidos. No cabe duda que la primera escala en el largo camino hacia una recuperacin del ritmo de crecimiento de la economa mundial, de forma sostenida y estable, tiene que ser el restablecimiento de la confianza, la generacin de certidumbres bsicas por parte de los lderes de las economas avanzadas, en armoniosa colaboracin con el Fondo Monetario Internacional, el cual no ha logrado materializar el papel del liderazgo en estos momentos difciles que muchos esperaban de l. En cambio, un hecho que distingue a Mxico es que en los ltimos aos, y especialmente durante el gobierno del Presidente Felipe Caldern, una constante en el mbito de la 3 poltica econmica ha sido la insistencia en generar certidumbre. Se ha sostenido, contra viento y marea, una poltica fiscal responsable; se ha mantenido un sistema bancario bien regulado y supervisado, extraordinariamente slido y solvente en comparacin con la banca de muchos otros pases. A su vez, el Banco Central ha ejercido a plenitud su autonoma sin apartarse del mandato constitucional que le ordena procurar la estabilidad de precios. Una comparacin que resulta de lo ms ilustrativa del progreso que hemos logrado en Mxico en materia de estabilizacin financiera, y que refleja la responsabilidad de la poltica fiscal y de la poltica monetaria que hemos seguido, es la que podemos hacer entre el plazo promedio ponderado de la deuda gubernamental en Mxico y la de Estados Unidos. 4 En 1994, el plazo promedio ponderado de la deuda gubernamental en pesos en Mxico era de 0.63 aos (230 das). Ese mismo ao, 1994, el plazo promedio ponderado de la deuda gubernamental en Estados Unidos era de 5.08 aos (alrededor de 1,854 das). Hoy, en Mxico el plazo promedio ponderado de la deuda gubernamental en pesos es de 7.4 aos (2,674 das) en tanto que el plazo promedio ponderado de la deuda del gobierno de Estados Unidos es de 5.2 aos (1,898 das). Esto significa que en Mxico no solamente hemos ampliado ms de once veces dicho plazo de 1994 a la fecha, sino que superamos a la deuda gubernamental de los Estados Unidos, en esos mismos trminos de plazo, por ms de dos aos. Esta comparacin sin duda refleja la confianza que los inversionistas le estn otorgando al gobierno de Mxico en materia de manejo macroeconmico, al grado de que estn dispuestos a confiarle su dinero por un plazo incluso mayor al 5 plazo en el que le confan su dinero al gobierno de los Estados Unidos. Justo con el mismo empeo de generar y garantizar certidumbre es lo que se ha hecho en el mbito especfico de los mercados financieros nacionales. Se han realizado un conjunto de reformas a su marco regulatorio que han propiciado su acelerado desarrollo. 1. En el mercado de cambios. El peso se ha convertido en una de las pocas divisas de pases emergentes que opera de manera continua las 24 horas del da, lo que le da una gran liquidez.  Hoy el peso mexicano ocupa el lugar nmero 13 entre las divisas ms operadas en el mundo, lo que nos sita, dentro de los pases emergentes, slo por debajo de Corea y Singapur. 6  Los diferenciales de compra-venta en los mercados interbancarios son comparables a los que se observan en las principales divisas del mundo: dlar, yen, euro o libra esterlina.  La mayor parte de las operaciones cambiarias se realizan hoy mediante plataformas electrnicas, garantizando una mayor transparencia en el proceso de formacin de precios y en la capacidad de ejecucin.  El factor decisivo detrs de todos estos avances ha sido la libre flotacin del peso desde finales de 1994. Las espordicas intervenciones del Banco de Mxico en el mercado cambiario se han dado en general bajo reglas predefinidas, transparentes y conocidas de antemano por todos los participantes. Adems, nuestras intervenciones se han hecho fundamentalmente con un objetivo en mente: garantizar el funcionamiento ordenado del mercado, procurando evitar que se generen situaciones de iliquidez que lleven a una 7 volatilidad excesiva en la cotizacin de la moneda nacional. Esto implica que desde hace muchos aos las autoridades financieras del pas hemos dejado de intervenir en el mercado cambiario persiguiendo un nivel especfico del tipo de cambio. Nuestra tesis ha sido que la nica manera de garantizar un nivel adecuado y estable de la paridad cambiaria, es manteniendo sanos los fundamentos de nuestra economa. Ciertamente puede haber desviaciones temporales de la cotizacin de la moneda nacional de su valor razonable, como ha sucedido recientemente como resultado de la gran turbulencia en los mercados externos, pero tengan la seguridad de que dicha cotizacin en el mediano plazo est fuertemente anclada a niveles ms bajos de los actuales por los fuertes fundamentos econmicos que tenemos. 8 2. En el mercado de valores gubernamentales. El Gobierno Federal ha sido capaz de crear y desarrollar un mercado de valores gubernamentales a plazos de hasta 30 aos tanto en tasa nominal fija, como en tasa real a travs de las UDIS.  Por supuesto, esto es producto de la poltica fiscal responsable que mencion y que no slo ha contribuido a la baja inflacin, sino que ha permitido extender los plazos de la deuda de manera muy ordenada, gracias a un programa de colocaciones de deuda predecible y disciplinado seguido por la Secretara de Hacienda.  La colocacin de estos valores mediante subastas ha sido clave para tener procesos de descubrimiento y formacin de precios totalmente transparentes. A su vez, las colocaciones sindicadas de las recientes emisiones han contribuido a incrementar la liquidez dando otro elemento de certidumbre a los mercados. 9  La figura de formadores de mercado se ha consolidado y permite darle ms liquidez y profundidad al mercado secundario, as como contar con la importante red de distribucin de las principales instituciones de crdito hacia inversionistas locales y extranjeros. 3. En el mercado de derivados. El desarrollo del mercado de cambios y la creacin de una curva de rendimiento lquida y de largo plazo en valores gubernamentales ha permitido, a su vez, el crecimiento de un mercado de instrumentos derivados lquido y eficiente, que tiene como subyacentes precisamente al tipo de cambio y a las tasas de inters.  Dicho desarrollo ha sido ms pronunciado en el mercado de derivados interbancario. No obstante, recientemente los futuros en Mexder referidos al tipo de cambio y a tasas de inters tambin han mostrado crecimientos importantes. Al respecto, la reciente alianza entre Mexder y el Chicago Merchantile Exchange deber 10 apuntalar an ms el desarrollo de nuestro mercado de derivados cotizados en bolsa, al traer una base importante de inversionistas extranjeros al mismo. Hay un claro desafo regulatorio que se adquiri al suscribir los compromisos del G-20 para una nueva regulacin de derivados. Para fines de 2012 tendremos que contar con:  La estandarizacin de los derivados que sean susceptibles de estandarizarse que se operan actualmente en los mercados interbancarios.  Plataformas electrnicas idneas para concertar las operaciones; ste es un tema en el que Mxico tiene ya un avance notable.  La liquidacin de las operaciones a travs de una contraparte central, y  Un repositorio de informacin de todas las operaciones que se celebren. 11 El desafo de estos cambios ser cumplir con las nuevas directrices sin perder la flexibilidad que han llegado a tener las operaciones de derivados en los mercados interbancarios o extraburstiles. --- 0 --Para concluir, quisiera hacer una reflexin final, regresando a la temtica de inicio de mi intervencin. Durante estos aos de la Administracin del Presidente Caldern nos hemos abocado a mantener y acrecentar la confianza en el mbito macroeconmico. Esta certidumbre, ya lo sabemos, es una condicin necesaria, pero no suficiente, para garantizar el crecimiento econmico sostenido y acelerado. Pero la estabilidad nos brinda los cimientos para emprender sin ms dilaciones las indispensables reformas estructurales que requerimos para crecer a tasas que sean mucho mayores que las actuales y de manera constante. 12 Este imperativo se hace hoy ms urgente que nunca ante la perspectiva de que las economas de Estados Unidos y Europa, que generan ms del 45% del PIB mundial, vivirn tiempos difciles y tendrn, en el mejor de los casos, un muy bajo crecimiento para los prximos aos, lo cual redundar en un menor impulso a la economa nacional. Precisamente para poder compensar esta falta de impulso externo en el futuro, es que se ha vuelto sumamente urgente la necesidad de hacer reformas estructurales. Simplemente no nos podemos seguir dando el lujo de la inaccin. Muchas gracias. 13

Title: Presentation of the Citibanamex Economics Award
text: Remarks by Mr. Alejandro Diaz de Leon, Governor of Banco de Mexico, during the presentation of the Citibanamex Economics Award. April 22, 2021 Mr. Manuel Romo, Managing Director of Citibanamex; Alberto Gomez Alcala, Corporate Director of Institutional Development, Economic Studies and Communication of Citibanamex, and President of the Citibanamex Award; Distinguished Officials and Academics Members of the Presidium; Ladies and gentlemen: 1 It is an honor to participate in the presentation of the Citibanamex Economics Award. This recognition was established in 1951, with which, it is already seventy years promoting the research of excellence in economics. From this award have emerged works that have served to solve economic and social problems, sustain public policies and innovate in different aspects of the economic discipline. I congratulate Citibanamex and all those who, throughout these decades, have contributed with their enthusiasm and work to make this award a benchmark in economic research in the country. In this speech I would like to refer to three themes: 1) the importance of economic research in the face of the challenges we face; 2) the role of research in the substantive work of the central bank and, 3) the relevance of the Citibanamex Award. Economic research and the changing present Change, in its various forms, is one of the characteristic elements of our times, and operates in contrasting facets. On the one hand, there are profound, historical transformations, 2 social, demographic or ecological, which pass gradually, almost imperceptibly, but at a given time, manifest their powerful impacts on the economy and society. On the other hand, the changes that arise suddenly, whether technological, financial crises or contingencies, such as the current pandemic, which occur unexpectedly and radically modify economic scenarios. To face these changes, whether gradual or sudden, it is essential to have adequate and robust theoretical models, empirical research, comparative economic history and timely and reliable factual information. In this sense, today more than ever, economic research, theoretical and applied, is fundamental to be able to respond in a better way to the challenges posed by our time. 3 In this regard, I would like to recall the words of Jean Tirole, Nobel Prize in economics, on the importance of balancing, in research, theory and practice: "As with most scientific disciplines, research in economics requires combining the theoretical with the empirical. Theory provides a framework for thinking. It is also key to understanding the data: without theory, without that pattern of interpretation, data are only interesting observations that do not tell us what we should deduce for economic policy. Conversely, theory is nourished by the empirical, which can invalidate its hypotheses and conclusions and lead us to abandon or improve it."1 Therefore, it is necessary to renew the paradigms in the light of the evidence and, on the other, to broaden the focus of the economy towards the new challenges that we must understand in depth. Thus, economic research entails in its essence, a transcendental search: to understand in order to transform. 1 Tirole, Jean, The economy of the common good, Mexico, Taurus, 2017. p. 96. 4 Economic research in its different facets helps to discern the different dimensions of change, to have a better understanding of reality and a greater capacity to respond to its challenges. Economic research makes it possible to observe the dynamics of the great evolutions that are operated gradually and to foresee their consequences. For example, the economic and financial consequences of climate change and the potential of green finance. Likewise, economic research makes it possible to assess, in historical retrospective, the effect of certain economic policies, such as, for example, the counterproductive results of the use of monetary expansion to boost the spending capacity of governments during the twentieth century. Economic research should also incorporate input from other disciplines in order to distinguish additional elements that influence the behavior of individuals, such as so-called behavioral economics. Therefore, in order to better navigate the challenges of the present reality, economic research is essential. This activity allows decision-making to take into account the past, 5 identify the most suitable frames of reference to which you are subject, evaluate various scenarios, keep in mind the common characteristics of successful development processes and consider the evidence of other sciences. The Bank of Mexico and the promotion of economic research One of the essential inputs to carry out the work of a central bank is economic research. In fact, a central bank's decision-making rests, in large part, on the quality, timeliness, and relevance of the information and economic research it has. Since its inception, the Bank of Mexico has been a constant source of information and has sought to develop research. One of the challenges faced by the nascent Bank of Mexico was the collection of statistics, as well as the establishment of information systems, which would allow the most relevant data on the Mexican economy to be integrated in a methodical and reliable way. 6 Since its inception, the Bank has promoted the internal production of research and has sought to attract and train the technical cadres it needs in this area. Through its areas of economic research, the Bank of Mexico has not only addressed central banking issues, such as inflation, monetary policy, financial stability or payment systems, but has also sought to make contributions on other central issues of the economy. The information and research generated by the central bank fulfills several functions: 1) allows a better understanding of the Bank's response strategy to different shocks and evaluates its performance; 2) it is a fundamental reference for economic agents and, 3) it is very useful for academic work and development scientist. In this sense, the information and economic research disseminated by the Bank of Mexico constitute a public good, of high value for society. 7 For this reason, the Bank of Mexico has always sought to link with the student and academic communities and maintain feedback with the different spaces and research institutions. Currently, the Bank has several programs of dissemination and university linkage and promotes two well-known reflection contests on economic issues for students of secondary and higher education. For all these reasons, the Bank of Mexico holds in high regard the Citibanamex Economics Award. The Citibanamex Award Throughout its several decades of validity, the Citibanamex Award has gained a wide and deserved prestige. This award has been a stimulus and a means of dissemination for economic research that is done around the problems of Mexico. The award promotes analytical and methodological rigor, operates on clear bases and has recognized works on different topics and with different theoretical approaches, thus contributing to plurality. 8 A brief review of the list of winning works in the last 70 years shows that this award has served to disseminate innovative theoretical approaches, key public policy issues, related to poverty, reforms to the social security system and pension schemes. Thus, many of the awarded works have contributed to address specific problems and have been contributions to the economic literature of their time. For the students or researchers who have received it, this award is a fundamental step in their professional career, and that distinguishes them, both for the competition with a large number of high quality works, and for the recognition and satisfaction of seeing the fruits of the work. The requirements of academic rigor, the transparency with which it is handled and the professional and economic incentive that this award implies has made it an emblematic recognition, capable of promoting and consolidating vocations in the field of economic research. Ladies and gentlemen, for the Bank of Mexico it is essential that there be various spaces, supports and stimuli, which promote rigorous reflection and 9 timely around the economy. As I pointed out earlier, understanding reality helps us transform it. Quality economic research is a strategic resource that helps to make better decisions, both public policy, corporate and individual level. Therefore, I warmly congratulate the winners of this edition, because with their discipline and talent they contribute to generate knowledge and useful tools to solve problems and take advantage of opportunities that arise in the Mexican economy. In addition, I am very pleased to find in the list of recognitions of this edition some colleagues of the Bank of Mexico. I can only reiterate my appreciation to Citibanamex for its consistent promotion of economic research on the problems of our country, a crucial activity to achieve a more equitable development and a better standard of living for all Mexicans. Thank you very much and congratulations to all. 10
text_original: Palabras del Lic. Alejandro Daz de Len, gobernador de Banco de Mxico, durante la entrega del Premio Citibanamex de economa. 22 de abril de 2021 Lic. Manuel Romo, Director General de Citibanamex; Lic. Alberto Gmez Alcal, Director Corporativo de Desarrollo Institucional, Estudios Econmicos y Comunicacin de Citibanamex, y Presidente del Premio Citibanamex; Distinguidos Funcionarios y Acadmicos Miembros del Presdium; Seoras y seores: 1 Es un honor participar en la entrega del Premio Citibanamex de Economa. Este reconocimiento fue establecido en 1951, con lo cual, ya son setenta aos impulsando la investigacin de excelencia en economa. De este premio han surgido trabajos que han servido para resolver problemas econmicos y sociales, sustentar polticas pblicas e innovar en distintos aspectos de la disciplina econmica. Felicito ampliamente a Citibanamex y a todos los que, a lo largo de estas dcadas, han contribuido con su entusiasmo y trabajo a hacer de este premio un referente en la investigacin econmica del pas. En esta intervencin quiero referirme a tres temas: 1) la importancia de la investigacin econmica ante los retos que enfrentamos; 2) el papel de la investigacin en las labores sustantivas del banco central y, 3) la relevancia del Premio Citibanamex. La investigacin econmica y el presente cambiante El cambio, en sus distintas formas, es uno de los elementos caractersticos de nuestros tiempos, y opera en facetas contrastantes. Por un lado, se presentan transformaciones profundas, histricas, 2 sociales, demogrficas o ecolgicas, que transcurren de manera gradual, casi imperceptible, pero en un momento dado, manifiestan sus poderosos impactos en la economa y la sociedad. Por otro lado, los cambios que surgen de manera repentina, ya sean tecnolgicos, crisis financieras o contingencias, como la actual pandemia, que se presentan de manera inesperada y modifican radicalmente los escenarios econmicos. Para enfrentar estos cambios, ya sean graduales o sbitos, resulta fundamental contar, con modelos tericos adecuados y robustos, investigacin emprica, historia econmica comparada e informacin factual oportuna y confiable. En este sentido, hoy ms que nunca, la investigacin econmica, terica y aplicada, es fundamental para poder responder de mejor manera a los retos que plantea nuestra poca. 3 Al respecto, me gustara recordar las palabras de Jean Tirole, Premio Nobel de economa, sobre la importancia de equilibrar, en la investigacin, la teora y la prctica: Como pasa con la mayora de las disciplinas cientficas, la investigacin en economa exige combinar lo terico con lo emprico. La teora proporciona un marco de pensamiento. Tambin es clave para comprender los datos: sin teora, sin esa pauta de interpretacin, los datos slo son observaciones interesantes que no nos dicen qu debemos deducir para la poltica econmica. A la inversa, la teora se nutre de lo emprico, que puede invalidar sus hiptesis y conclusiones y llevarnos a abandonarla o a mejorarla.1 Por ello, es necesario renovar los paradigmas a la luz de la evidencia y, por el otro, ampliar el enfoque de la economa hacia los nuevos retos que debemos entender a profundidad. As, la investigacin econmica conlleva en su esencia, una bsqueda trascendental: entender para transformar. 1 Tirole, Jean, La economa del bien comn, Mxico, Taurus, 2017. p. 96. 4 La investigacin econmica en sus distintas facetas ayuda a discernir las distintas dimensiones del cambio, a tener un mejor entendimiento de la realidad y una mayor capacidad de respuesta a sus retos. La investigacin econmica permite observar la dinmica de las grandes evoluciones que se operan de manera gradual y prever sus consecuencias. Por ejemplo, las secuelas econmicas y financieras del cambio climtico y el potencial de las finanzas verdes. Igualmente, la investigacin econmica permite valorar, en retrospectiva histrica, el efecto de determinadas polticas econmicas, como, por ejemplo, los resultados contraproducentes del uso de la expansin monetaria para impulsar la capacidad de gasto de los gobiernos durante el siglo XX. La investigacin econmica tambin debe incorporar aportaciones de otras disciplinas a fin de distinguir elementos adicionales que influyen en la conducta de los individuos, como en la llamada economa del comportamiento. Por lo anterior, para poder navegar de mejor manera ante los desafos de la realidad presente, la investigacin econmica es esencial. Esta actividad permite que la toma de decisiones tenga en cuenta al pasado, 5 identifique los marcos de referencia ms idneos a los que est sujeta, evale diversos escenarios, tenga presentes las caractersticas comunes de los procesos exitosos de desarrollo y considere las evidencias de otras ciencias. El Banco de Mxico y el impulso a la investigacin econmica Uno de los insumos esenciales para realizar la labor de un banco central es la investigacin econmica. De hecho, la toma de decisiones de un banco central descansa, en gran parte, en la calidad, oportunidad y relevancia de la informacin e investigacin econmica con la que cuente. Desde sus inicios, el Banco de Mxico ha sido una fuente constante de informacin y ha buscado desarrollar investigacin. Uno de los retos que enfrent el naciente Banco de Mxico fue la recopilacin de estadsticas, as como el establecimiento de sistemas de informacin, que permitieran integrar de manera metdica y confiable los datos ms relevantes en torno a la economa mexicana. 6 Desde sus inicios, el Banco ha promovido la produccin interna de investigacin y ha buscado atraer y formar los cuadros tcnicos que necesita en esta materia. A travs de sus reas de investigacin econmica, el Banco de Mxico no slo ha abordado temas de banca central, como la inflacin, la poltica monetaria, la estabilidad financiera o los sistemas de pagos, sino que tambin ha buscado hacer aportaciones en otros temas centrales de la economa. La informacin e investigacin generada por el banco central, cumple varias funciones: 1) permite conocer de mejor manera la estrategia de respuesta del Banco ante diferentes choques y evaluar su desempeo; 2) es un referente fundamental para los agentes econmicos y, 3) resulta de suma utilidad para el trabajo acadmico y el desarrollo cientfico. En este sentido, la informacin e investigacin econmica que difunde el Banco de Mxico constituyen un bien pblico, de alto valor para la sociedad. 7 Por ello, el Banco de Mxico ha buscado siempre vincularse con las comunidades estudiantiles y acadmicas y mantener retroalimentacin con los distintos espacios e instituciones de investigacin. Actualmente, el Banco cuenta con diversos programas de difusin y vinculacin universitaria e impulsa dos conocidos certmenes de reflexin sobre temas econmicos para estudiantes de educacin media y superior. Por todas estas razones, el Banco de Mxico tiene en gran consideracin al Premio de Economa Citibanamex. El premio Citibanamex A lo largo de sus varias dcadas de vigencia, el Premio Citibanamex ha ganado un amplio y merecido prestigio. Este premio ha constituido un estmulo y un medio de divulgacin para la investigacin econmica que se hace en torno a los problemas de Mxico. El premio promueve el rigor analtico y metodolgico, opera sobre bases claras y ha reconocido trabajos en distintos temas y con distintos enfoques tericos, contribuyendo as a la pluralidad. 8 Un breve repaso a la lista de los trabajos ganadores en los ltimos 70 aos demuestra que este premio ha servido para difundir enfoques tericos innovadores, temas claves de poltica pblica, relativos a la pobreza, a las reformas al sistema de seguridad social y los esquemas de pensiones. As, muchos de los trabajos premiados han contribuido a atender problemticas concretas y han sido contribuciones a la literatura econmica de su tiempo. Para los estudiantes o investigadores que lo han recibido, este premio es un paso fundamental en su trayectoria profesional, y que los distingue, tanto por la competencia con un gran nmero de trabajos de alta calidad, como por el reconocimiento y satisfaccin de ver los frutos del trabajo. Los requisitos de rigor acadmico, la transparencia con que se maneja y el incentivo profesional y econmico que implica este premio lo ha vuelto un reconocimiento emblemtico, capaz de impulsar y consolidar vocaciones en el mbito de la investigacin econmica. Seoras y seores: Para el Banco de Mxico es indispensable que existan diversos espacios, apoyos y estmulos, que impulsen la reflexin rigurosa y 9 oportuna en torno a la economa. Como sealaba anteriormente, entender la realidad nos ayuda a transformarla. La investigacin econmica de calidad constituye un recurso estratgico que ayuda a tomar mejores decisiones, tanto de poltica pblica, como a nivel corporativo e individual. Por eso, felicito calurosamente a los ganadores de esta edicin, pues con su disciplina y talento contribuyen a generar conocimientos y herramientas tiles para resolver problemas y aprovechar oportunidades que se presentan en la economa mexicana. No me queda sino reiterar mi reconocimiento a Citibanamex por su consistente impulso a la investigacin econmica sobre los problemas de nuestro pas, actividad crucial para lograr un desarrollo ms equitativo y un mejor nivel de vida para todos los mexicanos. Title: Presentation of the first report of the Financial System Stability Council
text: REMARKS BY THE GOVERNOR OF THE BANK OF MEXICO, DR. AGUSTIN CARSTENS, ON THE OCCASION OF THE PRESENTATION OF THE FIRST REPORT OF THE STABILITY COUNCIL OF THE FINANCIAL SYSTEM Mexico, Federal District, April 4, 2011 ? Mr. President of the Republic, Mr. Felipe Calderon Hinojosa ? Mr. Secretary of Finance and Public Credit, Maestro Ernesto Cordero Arroyo ? Mr. Juan Ignacio Gil Anton, President of the Mexican Association of Insurance Institutions ? Distinguished members of the Financial System Stability Council ? Distinguished representatives of financial system intermediaries ? Ladies and gentlemen, The real big challenge that the global crisis has left central banks has been to broaden their perspective to 1 which also covers the preservation of the country's financial stability, understood in a broad sense. Preserving financial stability is not an objective unrelated to that of combating inflation, but closely related to it. Both responsibilities support each other. Just as inflation deteriorates the wealth of families and nations, so financial instability cancels out sources of wealth creation. In both cases, instability - be it price or financial - is an insurmountable obstacle to achieving sustained economic growth. Even financial instability sooner or later can lead to a problem of higher inflation. Of course, the pursuit of financial stability cannot and should not be the sole function of the central bank, but also of the tax authorities and regulatory commissions. Precisely, meeting the challenge of ensuring financial stability requires a great deal of collaboration and cooperation between different authorities and regulators. In this regard, I welcome the fact that such cooperation and collaboration between authorities within the framework of the Financial System Stability Council is already under way in our country, so that we can 2 minimize the chances of a systemic crisis in our country. Surprisingly, the institutionalization of these coordination bodies is a recent phenomenon and only the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Union, India and Turkey have created spaces for this purpose. Other countries such as Canada, France and Germany are strengthening existing mechanisms. This puts Mexico at the forefront. In more specific terms, the Financial System Stability Council should focus on identifying and analyzing the risks that, due to their characteristics, may cause significant interruptions in the functioning of the financial system, to the extent that economic growth and the well-being of the population are threatened. It is important to note that the Council must focus not only on identifying risks, but also on prioritising those that may pose the greatest threat to financial stability. The Council should also issue policy recommendations that seek to mitigate the identified risks and, where appropriate, measures to try to minimize their impact when these risks materialize. 3 To achieve these objectives, three fundamental tasks must be carried out: obtaining the necessary information to identify threats to financial stability with opportunity. This goes beyond the collection of the financial statements of regulated financial intermediaries and the data that emerges from multiple markets. Information should be obtained on the financial positions and interrelationships between the different agents of the economy. The second activity consists of the analysis of the information collected in order to identify and measure the risk to establish priorities. To this end, it is important to develop a series of indicators and methodologies to measure systemic risk. Finally, it is necessary to carefully study which are the most suitable policies to prevent the identified risks from occurring, as well as those to mitigate the impact of them in case they materialize. Putting this into practice is not a simple task and requires a great initial effort and perseverance over time. It is an ongoing task and at no time can the authorities afford to let their guard down. 4 The report before us today bears witness to the work that has been done to date. Thus, in the present report, and as Secretary Cordero has already mentioned, the risks that the Council considers to be most important at this time are identified. Although it also points out that stability is not expected to be threatened even if these risks will materialize. This is largely due to the series of measures that the authorities have been taking in recent years and months to mitigate its potential impact. It is therefore a source of satisfaction that today we can say, Mr President, that the risks we have been able to identify are under control. However, this should not be a cause for complacency, as risks can materialize unusually in relatively short timeframes. A tangible manifestation of the degree of stability of the financial system that we have achieved is that today we are observing significant increases in the financial savings of Mexicans and a great interest of foreign investors to channel resources to Mexico, which has resulted in interest rates. 5 historically low and a significant growth of credit to companies and families in the country. These factors, together with the fact that macroeconomic consistency has been preserved through prudent and responsible fiscal and monetary policies, open the possibility for the financial sector to contribute decisively to Mexico's economic growth, which will result in more jobs and greater well-being for the population. This is, in the end, the object and raison d'etre for preserving and strengthening financial stability. Thanks a lot. 6
text_original: PALABRAS DEL GOBERNADOR DEL BANCO DE MEXICO, DOCTOR AGUSTIN CARSTENS, CON MOTIVO DE LA PRESENTACIN DEL PRIMER INFORME DEL CONSEJO DE ESTABILIDAD DEL SISTEMA FINANCIERO Mxico, Distrito Federal, 4 de abril de 2011  Seor Presidente de la Repblica, Licenciado Felipe Caldern Hinojosa  Seor Secretario de Hacienda y Crdito Pblico, Maestro Ernesto Cordero Arroyo  Licenciado Juan Ignacio Gil Antn, Presidente de la Asociacin Mexicana de Instituciones de Seguros  Distinguidos integrantes del Consejo de Estabilidad del Sistema Financiero  Distinguidos representantes de los intermediarios del sistemas financiero  Seoras y seores, El verdadero gran desafo que la crisis global ha dejado a los bancos centrales ha sido el de ampliar su perspectiva para 1 que abarque tambin la preservacin de la estabilidad financiera del pas entendida en un sentido amplio. Preservar la estabilidad financiera no es un objetivo ajeno al de combatir la inflacin, sino estrechamente emparentado con l. Una y otra responsabilidades se apoyan entre s. As como la inflacin deteriora la riqueza de las familias y de las naciones, del mismo modo la inestabilidad financiera cancela las fuentes de creacin de riqueza. En ambos casos, la inestabilidad  sea de precios, sea financiera- es un obstculo infranqueable para lograr el crecimiento econmico sostenido. Incluso la inestabilidad financiera tarde o temprano puede conducir a un problema de mayor inflacin. Por supuesto, la procuracin de la estabilidad financiera no puede ni debe ser exclusivamente funcin del banco central, sino tambin de las autoridades hacendarias y de las comisiones reguladoras. De manera precisa, hacer frente al desafo de garantizar la estabilidad financiera requiere de una gran colaboracin y cooperacin entre las distintas autoridades y reguladores. En este sentido celebro que ya estn en marcha en nuestro pas tal cooperacin y colaboracin entre autoridades en el mbito del Consejo de Estabilidad del Sistema Financiero, para que podamos 2 minimizar las probabilidades de una crisis sistmica en nuestro pas. Aunque parezca sorprendente, la institucionalizacin de estas instancias de coordinacin es un fenmeno reciente y slo Estados Unidos, el Reino Unido, la Unin Europea, India y Turqua han creado espacios con este fin. Otros pases como Canad, Francia y Alemania estn fortaleciendo mecanismos existentes. Esto pone a Mxico en la vanguardia. En trminos ms puntuales, el Consejo de Estabilidad del Sistema Financiero debe abocarse a identificar y analizar los riesgos que por sus caractersticas puedan provocar interrupciones significativas en el funcionamiento del sistema financiero, al grado que el crecimiento econmico y el bienestar de la poblacin se vean amenazados. Es importante sealar que el Consejo debe abocarse no solo a identificar riesgos, sino a priorizar aquellos que puedan llegar a representar una mayor amenaza para la estabilidad financiera. Asimismo, el Consejo deber emitir recomendaciones de polticas que procuren mitigar los riesgos identificados y, en su caso, medidas para tratar de minimizar su impacto cuando estos riesgos se materializan. 3 Para la consecucin de estos objetivos se deben llevar a cabo tres tareas fundamentales: obtener la informacin necesaria para identificar con oportunidad las amenazas a la estabilidad financiera. Lo anterior va ms all de la recopilacin de los estados financieros de los intermediarios financieros regulados y de los datos que se desprenden de mltiples mercados. Debe obtenerse informacin de las posiciones financieras e interrelaciones entre los diferentes agentes de la economa. La segunda actividad consiste en el anlisis de la informacin recabada con el fin de identificar y medir el riesgo para establecer prioridades. Para ello es importante desarrollar una serie de indicadores y metodologas para medir el riesgo sistmico. Por ltimo, se debe estudiar con cuidado cules son las polticas ms idneas para evitar que ocurran los riesgos identificados, as como aquellas para mitigar el impacto de los mismos en caso de que se materialicen. Llevar esto a la prctica no es una tarea sencilla y requiere de un gran esfuerzo inicial y perseverancia en el tiempo. Es una tarea continua y en ningn momento las autoridades se pueden dar el lujo de bajar la guardia. 4 El informe que hoy se presenta precisamente da testimonio de los trabajos que se han hecho hasta la fecha. As, en el presente informe, y como ya lo mencion el Secretario Cordero, se sealan los riesgos que el Consejo considera son ms importantes en este momento. Aunque tambin seala que no es de esperar que la estabilidad se vea amenazada an en el caso en que se materializarn dichos riesgos. Ello es debido en gran parte a la serie de medidas que las autoridades han estado tomando en los ltimos aos y meses para mitigar su impacto potencial. Por ello, es un motivo de satisfaccin que al da de hoy podamos decir, seor Presidente, que los riesgos que hemos podido identificar estn bajo control. Sin embargo, eso no debe ser causa de complacencia, pues los riesgos pueden materializarse de manera inusitada en plazos relativamente cortos. Una manifestacin tangible del grado de estabilidad del sistema financiero que hemos alcanzado es que al da de hoy estamos observando aumentos importantes en el ahorro financiero de los mexicanos y un gran inters de inversionistas extranjeros por canalizar recursos hacia Mxico, lo que ha redundado en tasas de inters 5 histricamente bajas y un crecimiento significativo del crdito a empresas y familias en el pas. Estos factores, junto con el hecho de que se ha preservado la congruencia macroeconmica a travs de polticas fiscales y monetarias prudentes y responsables, abren la posibilidad para que el sector financiero contribuya de manera decidida al crecimiento econmico de Mxico, lo que redundar en ms empleos y en mayor bienestar para la poblacin. Esto constituye, al final de cuentas, el objeto y la razn de ser por la cual resulta de tanta importancia preservar y fortalecer la estabilidad financiera. Muchas gracias. 6

Title: Signing of the collaboration agreement between the Bank of Mexico and the Attorney General's Office to prevent and combat crimes that threaten the security of monetary circulation
text: Remarks by the Governor of the Bank of Mexico, Agustin Carstens, during the signing ceremony of the collaboration agreement between the Bank of Mexico and the Attorney General's Office to prevent and combat crimes that threaten security in monetary circulation. Thursday, November 17, 2011 ? Madam Attorney General of the Republic, Teacher Marisela Morales Ibanez. ? Madam and Deputy Attorneys General ? Directors and coordinators of the Office of the Attorney General of the Republic ? Dear Ceos General Directors of Banco de Mexico ? Distinguished representatives of the media ? Ladies and gentlemen, Good afternoon. Welcome to the Bank of Mexico, to this historic Banking Room of our main building. As Attorney General Morales has already commented, almost ten years ago, in December 2001, the Attorney General's Office and the Bank of Mexico signed a collaboration agreement focused on preventing and combating crimes that threaten security in monetary circulation. Such security is an essential public good for coexistence 1 harmonious social and to sustain the trust that millions of users give day by day to the legal tender in Mexico. During these ten years the agreement has borne good fruit and has allowed each of the Institutions, within the scope of their responsibilities, and in accordance with the powers that the law grants to each of us, to work together reinforcing confidence in the coins and banknotes issued by the Bank of Mexico. The Attorney General's Office underpins this trust by preventing and prosecuting crimes that threaten the integrity of the currency, such as counterfeiting or alteration of the currency, as well as any attempt to produce, distribute or destroy national currency that is carried out outside the exclusive powers that the Constitution grants to the Bank of Mexico. It also has an impact on creating greater collective confidence in banknotes and coins as a means of payment by promoting a culture of reporting serious crimes such as counterfeiting or the deliberate distribution of counterfeit coins or banknotes. I want to take this opportunity to thank Attorney General Morales and all her collaborators in the PGR for the efforts and work they have deployed in this specific matter, despite the multitude of important tasks they carry out daily for the pursuit of justice and in favor of the security of all Mexicans. Thank you very much on behalf of myself and the Bank of Mexico. The Central Bank, in turn, constantly improves the security elements of banknotes and coins, resorting to the most advanced techniques in 2 the matter. In the same way, it informs the population about such security features, so that it can verify the authenticity of the banknotes or coins it receives, for example through touching, looking at and turning the banknotes to identify their security elements. The Central Bank also discloses the procedures that the population must follow in the case of receiving an allegedly false piece. Here, by the way, the recommendation is to go to a bank branch, in which the cashier will issue a receipt for the piece in question, which will be sent to the Bank of Mexico for an opinion. With this, the population also cooperates with its authorities by preventing the circulation of false pieces. An excellent example of the cooperation between our institutions are the announcements that you have been able to see on the monitors during the minutes prior to this event, which to date are being broadcast on various television channels throughout the country. Today, almost ten years away, it is time to renew this collaboration agreement between the two Institutions to further strengthen this fruitful joint work, establish more efficient mechanisms for the exchange of information, training and dissemination, and so that the agreement reflects in an appropriate way the changes that both institutions have experienced throughout this decade in their respective operating structures. For the Bank of Mexico, preserving the security of the circulation of legal tender is a priority issue. Not only because the Constitution mandates that we be the Single Bank of Issuance in the country, but 3 because the integrity of the coins and banknotes issued by the Bank of Mexico is an essential element for the best fulfillment of our priority objective, also indicated in the Constitution, which is to ensure the stability of the purchasing power of the currency, as well as for the objectives of promoting the healthy development of the financial system and the proper functioning of payment systems. It is obvious that for each and every one of these tasks and functions, it is crucial that the security of the circulating money is guaranteed. That is: the certainty that the money that millions of Mexicans and non-Mexicans use every day throughout the national territory to buy, sell, save, acquire credits, set contractual obligations at work or in the provision of services, carry out financial operations, is hard cash. Authentic money that is worth what it claims to be worth and that fulfills the three functions that economic science gives to money: Unit of account, medium of exchange and store of value. In the fulfillment of these three economic functions of money, the Central Bank also takes very punctual care that the banknotes and coins of Mexico have the appropriate quality, as well as that there are the quantities and denominations that the public demands, so that the flow of monetary transactions does not have interruptions due to exchange problems. If I were asked to summarize in a very short sentence the objective of this collaboration between the PGR and the Bank of Mexico, that phrase would be: to generate trust. And, well seen things, that: generating trust is what has characterized the vast majority of public policies that have followed 4 Mexico for more than 15 years: We have generated confidence through a responsible monetary policy, we have generated confidence through a fiscal policy that sets rigorous limits to the eventual deficits in the public balance and promotes its long-term balance, we have generated confidence with a timely and adequate banking supervision and regulation, which allows us to have today one of the most solid banking systems in the world and with greater growth potential. And today, when the economies of advanced countries, especially in Europe but also in the United States, face severe problems of over-indebtedness and weakness of financial institutions, problems that at their root are reduced to a crisis of confidence, Mexico has an invaluable asset thanks to having persevered in the generation of confidence. It is not time to boast, but to redouble the effort to continue generating confidence in all areas. For this reason, I have insisted that today it is more urgent than ever to consolidate the pending structural reforms in our country to grow faster, at higher rates and in a sustained manner. And that is why we also place great value on collaboration agreements such as the one we are signing today with the PGR, because it is about perfecting and deepening all public instruments that increase trust and certainty. A difficult global environment fraught with uncertainty makes the task of building trust more valuable every day, 5 mission in which all the institutions of the Mexican State must commit. Thanks a lot. 6
