Title: Financial education and innovation
text: Financial Education and Innovation Words of Manuel Sanchez Gonzalez Deputy Governor of the Bank of Mexico at the opening of the IV Annual Conference of the International Federation of Finance Museums Mexico City September 9, 2016 It is a great honor to participate, with the representation of the Bank of Mexico, in the inauguration of the IV Annual Conference of the International Federation of Finance Museums. The program of this meeting emphasizes the theme of financial education and brings together important personalities to discuss it. The rise of a notion For some decades, financial instruction has acquired increasing relevance in many countries. Efforts have been made by governments, international institutions, central banks and private intermediaries to promote it. There are several reasons why financial education is now essential. Many segments of the population do not have access to any financial services or use informal means of intermediation that often involve high costs, risks and limitations for the user. In addition, the emergence of new financial products implies, for their acquisition and management, the need for timely information and specialized knowledge. In addition, due to changes in the social security systems of many countries, consumers have to make numerous complicated financial decisions with long-term effects. Such is the case of pension, health or child education schemes, which were previously adopted by the State. 1 The Bank of Mexico and financial education Interest in financial education has become more urgent after the global crisis of the past decade, which was largely attributed to the oversaturation of risks by insufficiently informed participants in the financial system. Given that, since 2008, central banks have played an increasingly active role in managing the crisis and its aftermath, their increased interest in the subject is natural. For a central bank, a higher level of financial training implies a virtuous circle, as this can lead to a better social understanding of its own policies. In addition, a well-informed population tends to be more demanding of their rights, contributing to increased competition in the sector. Finally, a society educated in financial matters makes better decisions and limits its risks and, with it, the probability of accumulating systemic imbalances and dangers. Within the mandate of the Bank of Mexico to promote the healthy development of the financial system, the dissemination of relevant information for the best consumer decision-making is inserted, as well as the promotion of competition and transparency within the sector. In general, it is sought that the citizen has sufficient, timely, understandable and homogeneous information regarding the different products offered by the financial system. This implies knowing not only the rights but also the 2 responsibilities that are acquired when hiring a product, as well as having at hand comparative figures and alternative options. In this regard, regulation has made significant progress. In financial products there is greater transparency regarding their conditions and characteristics, and there is greater ease to, where appropriate, cancel current contracts and choose other options. To mention a few examples, the Annual Total Cost (CAT) and the Total Annual Profit (GAT) are standard indicators that allow credit users and savers, respectively, to know the conditions of the products and compare them with those offered by other providers, in order to make better decisions. Likewise, the Bank of Mexico periodically publishes a family of reports with basic credit indicators with which comparisons of the conditions of the contracts, such as interest rates and commissions, can be established. In addition, this central institute has designed online tools to calculate the comparative cost of various banking services. All this gives the consumer greater decision-making power. In addition, the Bank of Mexico has ventured into the area of financial education with an offer aimed at various audiences. In particular, it has deployed a 3 a wide range of mechanisms from tools aimed at children, such as the "Mibanxico" site, to competitions such as the "Contacto Banxico" award, in which high school students elaborate essays on various central banking topics, and programs to link with university students on monetary issues. Likewise, social networks, such as Twitter and Facebook, have been used to provide timely information and disseminate the functions and work of this institution. With a longer-term approach, the Bank of Mexico spearheaded the project to create a museum specializing in economics that would contribute to dissemination, recreation and financial education. This idea crystallized at the Interactive Museum of Economics (MIDE), generous host of this symposium. In the course of a decade, MIDE has established itself as a cutting-edge space that in its facilities and digital platforms disseminates knowledge of economics and finance with innovative methods. Thanks to its hard work, MIDE has become an international benchmark within the museums of economy. The future of financial education The issue of financial education will continue to be very significant at the international level and at the Mexican level. There are various currents in the field of financial education. At one extreme, the traditional approach assumes the rational choice of individuals and considers that it is enough to offer them theoretical knowledge. 4 and timely information to ensure your best decisions. In the other, the findings of behavioral economics bet on a practical training that identifies irrational psychological impulses and behavioral biases of the individual in financial matters, and that contributes to channel them positively. The relative merit of the different currents will continue to be a matter of empirical inquiry.1 Likewise, the design of financial education must take into account the evolution of technology and the way in which it not only modifies products, but also changes patterns of behavior and financial reasoning of the new generations. For example, by leveraging the extensive use of technological innovations and digital platforms, so-called FinTech companies have driven greater financial inclusion. Using the internet and social networks have generated alternative sources of financing such as the so-called crowfunding. Likewise, new business models and market niches have been identified, such as student financing. Thus, in the field of FinTech, ways can be found not only to overcome geographical barriers, improve risk selection and lower the costs of access to 1 Eugene F. Fama and Richard H. Thaler present their views on these approaches in Fama E.F. and R.H. Thaler, (2016). "Are Markets Efficient?" Chicago Booth Review, Fall. 5 services, but to optimize the information of the users and provide them with new capabilities. Undoubtedly, in the use of new approaches applied to financial services we must be as open as prudent and extract the best virtues.2 In sum, during the last decade, the Bank of Mexico, together with other authorities in the field, has explored better ways to disseminate information and extend the economic and financial knowledge of various audiences. However, there is still a long way to go. Therefore, I welcome the fact that MIDE, which in its brief history has had such an impact on economic and financial instruction, is hosting this forum. I am sure that they will reach valuable and useful conclusions on this fundamental issue of our time. 2 For a very synthetic picture of FinTech, its impact on the financial system and its challenges towards central banking, see Carney, M. (2016). "Enabling the FinTech transformation - revolution, restoration, or reformation?" Speech presented at the Lord Mayor's Banquet for Bankers and Merchants of the City of London, Mansion House, London, June. 6

El programa de este encuentro pone nfasis en el tema de la educacin financiera y congrega a importantes personalidades para discutirlo. El auge de una nocin Desde hace algunos lustros, la instruccin financiera ha adquirido una creciente relevancia en muchos pases. Se han realizado esfuerzos de gobiernos, instituciones internacionales, bancos centrales e intermediarios privados para promoverla. Dado que, desde 2008, los bancos centrales han ejercido un papel cada vez ms activo en la gestin de la crisis y sus secuelas, resulta natural su mayor inters en el tema. Para un banco central un mayor nivel de capacitacin financiera implica un crculo virtuoso, ya que ello puede propiciar un mejor entendimiento social de sus propias polticas. En lo general, se busca que el ciudadano disponga de informacin suficiente, oportuna, entendible y homognea respecto a los diferentes productos que ofrece el sistema financiero. Ello implica conocer no slo los derechos sino las 2 responsabilidades que se adquieren al contratar un producto, as como tener a la mano cifras comparativas y opciones alternas. Al respecto, la regulacin ha logrado importantes avances. Por mencionar algunos ejemplos, el Costo Total Anual (CAT) y la Ganancia Total Anual (GAT) son indicadores estndares que permiten a los usuarios de crdito y a los ahorradores, respectivamente, conocer las condiciones de los productos y compararlos con los que ofrecen otros proveedores, a fin de tomar mejores decisiones. Igualmente, el Banco de Mxico publica peridicamente una familia de reportes con indicadores bsicos de crdito con los que se pueden establecer comparaciones de las condiciones de los contratos, como las tasas de inters y las comisiones. Asimismo, este instituto central ha diseado herramientas en lnea para calcular el costo comparativo de diversos servicios bancarios. Todo ello brinda al consumidor un mayor poder de decisin. Adems, el Banco de Mxico ha incursionado en el rea de la educacin financiera con una oferta dirigida a diversas audiencias. En particular, ha desplegado una 3 amplia gama de mecanismos desde herramientas dirigidas al pblico infantil, como el sitio Mibanxico, hasta certmenes como el premio Contacto Banxico, en el que alumnos de preparatoria elaboran ensayos sobre diversos tpicos de banca central, y programas de vinculacin con universitarios en temas monetarios. Igualmente, se han aprovechado las redes sociales, como Twitter y Facebook, para brindar informacin oportuna y difundir las funciones y labores de esta institucin. Con un enfoque de ms largo plazo, el Banco de Mxico encabez el proyecto de crear un museo especializado en economa que contribuyera a la difusin, recreacin y educacin financiera. Esta idea cristaliz en el Museo Interactivo de Economa (MIDE), anfitrin generoso de este simposio. En el curso de una dcada, el MIDE se ha consolidado como un espacio de vanguardia que en sus instalaciones y plataformas digitales difunde el conocimiento de economa y finanzas con mtodos innovadores. Gracias a su denodada labor, el MIDE se ha convertido en un referente internacional dentro de los museos de economa. El futuro de la educacin financiera El tema de la educacin financiera seguir siendo muy significativo en el plano internacional y en el mbito mexicano. Existen diversas corrientes en materia de educacin financiera. En un extremo, el enfoque tradicional supone la eleccin racional de los individuos y considera que basta ofrecerles conocimientos tericos 4 e informacin puntual para garantizar sus mejores decisiones. En el otro, los hallazgos de la economa del comportamiento apuestan por una capacitacin prctica que identifique impulsos psicolgicos irracionales y sesgos conductuales del individuo en materia financiera, y que contribuya a encauzarlos positivamente. El mrito relativo de las diferentes corrientes seguir siendo motivo de indagacin emprica.1 Igualmente, el diseo de la educacin financiera debe tomar en cuenta la evolucin de la tecnologa y la manera en que sta no slo modifica los productos, sino cambia patrones de comportamiento y razonamiento financiero de las nuevas generaciones. Sin duda, en el uso de los nuevos enfoques aplicados a los servicios financieros debemos ser tan abiertos como prudentes y extraer las mejores virtudes.2 En suma, durante la ltima dcada, el Banco de Mxico, junto con otras autoridades en la materia, ha explorado mejores formas de difundir informacin y extender los conocimientos econmicos y financieros de diversas audiencias.
