Se le ha titulado Seguridad y Confianza: 90 aos de Billetes del Banco de Mxico, pues tales atributos son esenciales para que el dinero desempee sus funciones. En esta ocasin, me gustara enfocar mis comentarios en la importancia de la confianza en el dinero. La confianza en el dinero El papel esencial del dinero consiste en ser un medio de pago universalmente aceptado. Su presencia hace posible superar las dificultades del trueque, el cual requiere la coincidencia exacta de las distintas necesidades de los individuos que interactan en los intercambios. El medio monetario, en contraste, permite ampliar el nmero y la variedad de las transacciones, as como las posibilidades de produccin y de despliegue de otras actividades econmicas. Debe apuntarse que el dinero fue originalmente una invencin social espontnea. En las culturas primitivas, las comunidades usaron objetos considerados tiles para facilitar el comercio. Sin embargo, a lo largo del tiempo, las autoridades de los 1 pases intervinieron estableciendo reglas para la emisin y circulacin del dinero. Esta injerencia buscaba aumentar la aceptacin de este instrumento, lo que no siempre se logr.1 Una caracterstica fundamental para la admisin del dinero ha sido la confianza del pblico en su capacidad de servir como herramienta de pago. Inicialmente, sta se deposit en el atractivo del material mismo del que estaba hecho el dinero. De esta manera, resultaba habitual el uso, como medio de pago, de materias primas asociadas con algn smbolo ritual, como las conchas y las plumas de aves exticas, o de metales preciosos con notorias cualidades ornamentales, como el oro y la plata. Por muchos siglos, la intervencin de los soberanos se manifest en la forma de acuacin de monedas con metales preciosos. En la era moderna, en cambio, los medios de dinero primario, como los billetes y las monedas emitidos por los bancos centrales, constituyen promesas de pago sin valor intrnseco. La ventaja de este dinero fiduciario es su relativamente bajo costo de produccin, que lo convierte en un medio eficiente de pago al distraer pocos recursos de la economa. Sin embargo, precisamente por la carencia de valor intrnseco, la confianza en el dinero moderno se fundamenta en la capacidad de la autoridad de 1 Para una revisin del surgimiento espontneo del dinero, ver Menger, C. (1892). On the Origin of Money, Economic Journal, (2). 2 convencer al pblico de que tal medio servir adecuadamente el propsito de liquidar pagos. El deterioro de la confianza De ah que un aspecto primordial para el uso amplio del dinero, en cualquiera de sus manifestaciones, sea que su poder adquisitivo se conserve. A lo largo de la historia, el valor del dinero se ha vulnerado repetidamente, lo que en casos extremos ha llevado a su repudio total. La causa recurrente de deterioro de la utilidad del dinero ha sido la trivializacin del mismo impulsada a menudo por aquellas autoridades que fungen como sus garantes. Esto ocurri, por ejemplo, cuando en el pasado, debido a la necesidad de aumentar la acuacin para financiar guerras o ritmos de vida fastuosos de las monarquas, algunas monedas disminuyeron su contenido de metal precioso, generando incertidumbre y rechazo en los usuarios. Igualmente, cuando se introdujo el papel moneda convertible a metales preciosos, la confianza se da en los casos en que la emisin de billetes super la capacidad de sufragar las conversiones, generando la reticencia ante este instrumento. En la poca moderna, el principal factor de desconfianza en el dinero ha sido el escalamiento de la inflacin, que es en ltima instancia una consecuencia del aumento excesivo de la oferta monetaria. Hay ejemplos histricos de la erosin del 3 poder adquisitivo que incluso llevaron a algunas economas a involucionar hasta el trueque y a que los billetes perdieran casi cualquier valor y estima social. En los casos ms dramticos de hiperinflaciones a lo largo del siglo pasado, como la ocurrida durante los aos veinte en la Repblica de Weimar, los billetes llegaron a usarse para tapizar paredes o prender cigarros. En Mxico, sin llegar a estos extremos, los episodios de desconfianza en el dinero han sido, por desgracia, frecuentes. En particular, a diferencia de la moneda virreinal acuada en metales preciosos, que logr gran aceptacin y credibilidad no solo en la Nueva Espaa sino internacionalmente, el dinero fiduciario enfrent problemas para consolidarse como medio de pago reconocido. Por ejemplo, cuando tras la Independencia se introdujo el papel moneda en nuestro pas, la inestabilidad poltica y econmica imperante se tradujo en una falta de credibilidad monetaria. Ni el billete del Imperio de Iturbide, ni el republicano, que en un intento desesperado de alcanzar aceptacin se imprima en el reverso de bulas papales, lograron su utilizacin como herramienta extendida y, a la postre, tuvieron que salir de circulacin. Otro paradigma de desconfianza podemos observarlo con el estallido de la Revolucin Mexicana cuando, debido a la emisin abundante y desordenada por parte de las diversas facciones en pugna, el papel moneda se depreci hasta perder su valor de uso. 4 Si bien en 1925 el Banco de Mxico asumi las funciones de emisor nico, la restauracin de la confianza de los usuarios en los billetes fue inicialmente difcil y no han escaseado episodios adicionales de desconfianza. Una etapa de suspicacia en torno a la moneda ocurri en los aos ochenta del siglo pasado cuando se registr la ms elevada inflacin anual de la historia moderna de nuestro pas, que lleg a alcanzar 180 por ciento en febrero de 1988. Ante el persistente problema de la inflacin, en los aos noventa se ensayaron, con resultados poco halageos, frmulas de combate heterodoxas, que incluyeron controles de precios bajo la modalidad de pactos de concertacin social. Estos episodios afectaron severamente la certidumbre en la moneda, daando la economa y reduciendo el bienestar social, al tiempo que reflejaron una desconfianza en el poder de la poltica monetaria. De hecho, en algunos crculos lleg a plantearse la discusin de si era preferible adoptar el dlar como la moneda de curso legal.2 La recuperacin de la confianza Ha sido durante el presente siglo cuando se han consolidado las bases para una mayor confianza en el dinero en Mxico. Ello ha sido as porque, en este lapso se ha 2 Esta desconfianza en el poder de la poltica monetaria no ha sido privativa de Mxico. Para una exposicin de los argumentos que explican la elevada inflacin de Estados Unidos en los aos 70s vase, por ejemplo, Romer, C. D. y D. H. Romer (2013). The Most Dangerous Idea in Federal Reserve History: Monetary Policy Doesnt Matter, American Economic Review: Papers & Proceedings, 103(3). 5 ejercido el poder de la poltica monetaria para controlar la inflacin. La reduccin en el crecimiento anual de los precios ha sido notable, hasta alcanzar en 2015 no solamente el objetivo permanente de inflacin de 3 por ciento establecido desde 2003, sino sucesivos mnimos histricos por debajo de esta referencia. Para el abatimiento de la inflacin han influido dos factores esenciales: por una parte, el ejercicio de facto de la autonoma del Banco de Mxico y, por otra, un compromiso de la poltica monetaria de procurar la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda, mandato establecido en la Constitucin. Como en muchos otros pases, la estrategia monetaria se ha basado en objetivos explcitos de inflacin, con un rgimen cambiario de libre flotacin. El mantenimiento de una inflacin baja implica una extraordinaria ganancia social pues brinda a las empresas un entorno de mayor certidumbre para la planeacin de proyectos productivos; permite que las familias tomen mejores decisiones de consumo y ahorro; y ayuda a crear empleos, as como a preservar el valor real de los salarios. Por eso, debemos apreciar y resguardar este logro que hemos alcanzado como sociedad y reaccionar con oportunidad y energa ante cualquier fenmeno que lo ponga en peligro. El Banco de Mxico est plenamente comprometido con su objetivo institucional de procurar la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda nacional. 6 Conclusin Podemos concluir que la mayor confianza alcanzada en el uso de la moneda nacional y los medios de pagos que en ella se sustentan han generado beneficios significativos a nuestro pas. Sin embargo, el billete mexicano cuenta tambin con un gran valor histrico y belleza, que podrn apreciar el da de hoy en esta esplndida exposicin. El acervo del billete es una ventana privilegiada a nuestra historia, nuestra cultura y nuestra sensibilidad. En dicha coleccin pueden encontrarse desde piezas pintorescas y rudimentarias hasta exquisitos ejemplares de billetes contemporneos, cuya esttica y refinada factura en el diseo y el grabado les han hecho ganar numerosos reconocimientos. Los invito a que, juntos, hagamos este extraordinario recorrido por el pasado y el presente de nuestros billetes. 7

Title: Second National Convention of AFORES and Fifteenth FIAP International Seminar
text: Remarks by the Governor of the Bank of Mexico, Agustin Carstens, on the occasion of the Second National Convention of AFORES and the Fifteenth FIAP International Seminar. Mexico City, October 30, 2017 Dr. Carlos Noriega Curtis - President of AMAFORE, Mr. Guillermo Arthur - President of FIAP, Carlos Ramirez - President of CONSAR, Ladies and Gentlemen: Good afternoon. It is a pleasure and an honor to have received your invitation to this convention. This gives me the opportunity to share with you some reflections on the significant impact that the reform of the pension system has had in our country. In particular, throughout my talk, I will emphasize how this reform has complemented the gradual development of the institutional framework in our country to create a virtuous circle consisting of a greater generation of resources that deepen the financial system, enhance economic growth and contribute to 1 mitigate pressures on inflation, which in turn induces even greater savings, thus restarting the virtuous circle. In recent decades, various actions have been carried out that have strengthened the country's macroeconomic framework. A first set of structural reforms with this objective took place in the nineties and early 2000s, highlighting: the autonomy of the central bank and the adoption of a monetary policy aimed at price stability; the implementation of a flexible exchange rate regime; the adoption of laws with a view to strengthening the regulatory and supervisory framework to keep the financial system healthy; strengthening public finances through the enactment of various laws, such as the Federal Law on Budget and Financial Responsibility; and, crucially, the reform of the pension system, in particular the reform of the Retirement Savings System (SAR) of 1997. To explain the virtuous circle to which I alluded earlier, and around which my presentation will revolve, it is important to first understand how the financial system as a whole has been transforming over the past 20 years, which could hardly have been possible without the SAR reform in 1997. The change to a regime of individualized accounts 2 generated a mechanism that induced greater financial savings, particularly long-term, which in the first place strengthened the public debt market, by making it possible for the government to finance itself through the placement of securities with increasingly longer terms. In turn, progress in macro-financial stabilization allowed the extension of the yield curve of government securities, which in turn facilitated the development of other financing markets, by serving as a reference for the determination of prices of long-term debt securities issued by companies, public or private, and by states. Later, CONSAR authorized siefores to make investments in equity instruments and securities issued abroad. Indeed, since 2005 there has been a constant effort by CONSAR to expand investment possibilities in a growing range of financial assets, many of which are intimately connected with tangible investment projects. While government securities accounted for 98% of the siefores portfolio in 1998, this proportion fell to 82% in 2005 and to 51% today. 3 Given the relevance of the resources administered in the Retirement Savings System, their impact on the economy has tended to be increasingly significant. In this regard, the greater channeling of resources towards the investment of large-scale projects has had positive effects on the potential growth capacity of the economy, making Mexico an increasingly productive and competitive economy at the global level. This increase in productivity allows the economy to expand at a faster pace, but without generating pressures on inflation, reaching higher levels of consumption and investment without pressuring the cost of productive factors. In other words, it is possible to achieve greater well-being without this having an impact on inflation. On the other hand, the development of financial markets, which is reflected in their greater depth and better functioning, has contributed to increasing the efficiency of the conduct of monetary policy. In effect, it affects inflation through different transmission channels, including interest rates and credit. To the extent that a healthy and deep financial system is in place, central bank actions will have an effect along the entire yield curve, impacting not only short rates. 4 term, but also to those of longer terms. The latter, in turn, are the most important to influence consumption and investment decisions. Thus, the aforementioned channels of transmission of monetary policy are strengthened. This greater strength allows the actions of the monetary authority to be more efficient and manage to bring inflation to its target with a lower cost in terms of economic activity. The effective conduct of monetary policy has resulted in important achievements in reducing inflation, compared to the phenomena observed decades ago. Inflation has decreased significantly not only in its level, but also in its volatility and persistence, allowing greater planning horizons for households and companies. The anchoring of inflation expectations has led to a decline in risk premia, mainly in inflationary risk. All this has led to a decrease in nominal interest rates, which in turn has allowed greater growth in credit and financial inclusion, encouraging investment and the potential growth of the economy. It should be remembered that an environment characterized by high and volatile inflation discourages saving and investment decisions in the economy, so that the 5 Benefits that greater savings imply on economic activity are increased to the extent that an environment of low and stable inflation facilitates the generation of even greater savings. Thus, it is at this point that the virtuous circle that occurs thanks to the synergies generated by the reform of the pension system and the autonomy of the Bank of Mexico is closed, with its consequent impact on savings in our country. That is, the role of the SAR is complemented by, and benefits from, the strengthening of the institutional framework that has been taking place in parallel in our country in the last almost 25 years, highlighting the autonomy obtained by the Bank of Mexico in 1994 for the exercise of its powers. In this regard, based on its constitutional mandate, the Bank has implemented a monetary policy aimed at achieving low and stable inflation, which, as I have already described, encourages greater savings from the private sector and allows the savings-financing-investment-productivity cycle to begin again, growth-low inflation-savings. In this way, these institutional changes have left an indelible mark on the strengthening of the financial system and on the ability of our economy to absorb adverse shocks. 6 However, despite the important contributions to strengthening the macroeconomic framework and the well-being of Mexican workers that have resulted from the SAR reform of 1997, the pension system in our country still faces enormous challenges that must be tackled from multiple flanks and in a coordinated manner. One of the most relevant is the expansion of SAR coverage. As we know, the current pension system has low coverage. In the first quarter of 2016, social security contributors in Mexico represented only 27 percent of the population of working age, which places our country below many countries such as Chile (40%), Costa Rica (41%), Panama (47%), Uruguay (65%) according to data from the International Labor Organization. This could be explained by many factors. The first is of a structural nature and refers to the high degree of informality of the labor force of our country. Indeed, despite the important advances that have been observed in the dynamics of formal employment in the last five years, in which this type of work has grown 1.8 times more than the economy as a whole, today out of every ten employees, six work in the informal sector. A second factor could be 7 linked to the perception by workers that commissions are still high, net returns per weight saved insufficient, and complicated procedures. This discourages workers from joining and staying in the system early. Related to the above, another relevant challenge is to implement policies to increase the amount that workers receive at the time of their retirement. For this, it is important to establish measures that are reflected in greater contributions to the accounts of workers in the siefores, both in their mandatory and voluntary components. That is no easy task. For example, while establishing an increase in mandatory contributions might be reasonable, especially considering that contribution rates in Mexico are low compared to those in other countries, this measure alone could generate incentives that would favor informal employment, eroding the base of taxpayers and future pensioners. But it is not an impossible task either. One could think of creative schemes such as those fostered by behavioral economists such as Richard Thaler, the recent winner of the Nobel Prize in Economics, by automatically enrolling workers to 8 contribute to their pension plans, pre-establishing a proportion of the salary that is saved from the moment the employee joins a company, even if he can later reduce this proportion himself. Yes, there are still significant challenges ahead. But I am convinced that with the will and commitment of the institutions, the authorities and the employers' and trade union sector, which have been working together for the development and progress of the SAR in recent decades, consensus will be reached and the necessary measures will be implemented for the benefit of the workers and the country as a whole. I end by congratulating everyone for contributing, from various fronts, to building a better future for several generations of Mexicans. Thanks a lot. 9
text_original: Palabras del Gobernador del Banco de Mxico, Agustn Carstens, con motivo de la Segunda Convencin Nacional de AFORES y el Dcimo Quinto Seminario Internacional FIAP. Ciudad de Mxico, 30 de octubre de 2017 Dr. Carlos Noriega Curtis  Presidente de AMAFORE, Sr. Guillermo Arthur - Presidente de FIAP, Carlos Ramrez  Presidente de CONSAR, Seoras y seores: Muy buenas tardes. Es un gusto y un honor haber recibido su invitacin a esta convencin. Ello me da la oportunidad de compartir con ustedes algunas reflexiones sobre el impacto tan significativo que ha tenido la reforma al sistema de pensiones en nuestro pas. En particular, a lo largo de mi charla, enfatizar cmo esta reforma ha complementado el gradual desarrollo del marco institucional en nuestro pas para crear un crculo virtuoso consistente en una mayor generacin de recursos que profundizan el sistema financiero, potencian el crecimiento econmico y contribuyen a 1 mitigar las presiones sobre la inflacin, lo que a su vez induce un ahorro an mayor, reinicindose as el circulo virtuoso. En las ltimas dcadas se han llevado a cabo diversas acciones que han fortalecido el marco macroeconmico del pas. Un primer conjunto de reformas estructurales con este objetivo se dio en la dcada de los noventa y a principios de los aos 2000, destacando: la autonoma del banco central y la adopcin de una poltica monetaria orientada a la estabilidad de precios; la implementacin de un rgimen de tipo de cambio flexible; la aprobacin de leyes con miras a fortalecer el marco de regulacin y supervisin para mantener al sistema financiero sano; el fortalecimiento de las finanzas pblicas a travs de la promulgacin de diversas leyes, como la Ley Federal de Presupuesto y Responsabilidad Hacendaria; y, de forma crucial, la reforma al sistema de pensiones, en particular la reforma al Sistema del Ahorro para el Retiro (SAR) de 1997. Para explicar el crculo virtuoso al que alud antes, y alrededor del cual girar mi presentacin, es importante entender primero cmo se ha venido transformando el sistema financiero en su conjunto en los ltimos 20 aos, lo cual difcilmente podra haber sido posible sin la reforma al SAR en 1997. El cambio a un rgimen de cuentas individualizadas 2 gener un mecanismo que indujo un mayor ahorro financiero, en particular de largo plazo, lo que en primer trmino fortaleci el mercado de deuda pblica, al hacer posible que el gobierno se pudiera financiar a travs de la colocacin de valores con plazos cada vez ms largos. A su vez, el progreso en la estabilizacin macrofinanciera permiti la extensin de la curva de rendimientos de ttulos gubernamentales, lo que a su vez facilit el desarrollo de otros mercados de financiamiento, al servir como referencia dicha curva para la determinacin de precios de los ttulos de deuda de largo plazo emitidos por empresas, pblicas o privadas, y por entidades federativas. Ms tarde la CONSAR dio autorizacin a las siefores para realizar inversiones en instrumentos de renta variable y valores emitidos en el exterior. De hecho, a partir de 2005 ha habido un esfuerzo constante de la CONSAR para ampliar las posibilidades de inversin en una gama cada vez mayor de activos financieros, muchos de los cuales estn ntimamente conectados con proyectos de inversin tangibles. Mientras que los valores gubernamentales representaban un 98 por ciento de la cartera de las siefores en 1998, esta proporcin se redujo a 82 por ciento en 2005 y a un 51 por ciento en la actualidad. 3 Dada la relevancia que han cobrado los recursos administrados en el Sistema de Ahorro para el Retiro, su impacto en la economa ha tendido a ser cada vez ms significativo. A este respecto, la mayor canalizacin de recursos hacia la inversin de proyectos de gran envergadura ha tenido efectos positivos sobre la capacidad de crecimiento potencial de la economa, haciendo que Mxico sea una economa cada vez ms productiva y competitiva a nivel global. Este aumento en la productividad permite que la economa se expanda a un mayor ritmo, pero sin generar presiones sobre la inflacin, alcanzando niveles ms elevados de consumo e inversin sin presionar el costo de los factores productivos. En otras palabras, es posible alcanzar un mayor bienestar sin que ello repercuta en la inflacin. Por otra parte, el desarrollo de los mercados financieros, que se refleja en una mayor profundidad y mejor funcionamiento de los mismos, ha contribuido a incrementar la eficiencia de la conduccin de la poltica monetaria. En efecto, sta incide en la inflacin a travs de distintos canales de transmisin, incluyendo el de tasas de inters y el crediticio. En la medida en que se cuente con un sistema financiero sano y profundo, las acciones del banco central tendrn efecto a lo largo de toda la curva de rendimientos, impactando no solo a las tasas de corto 4 plazo, sino tambin a las de plazos ms largos. Estas ltimas, a su vez, son las ms importantes para ejercer influencia sobre las decisiones de consumo e inversin. As, los canales de transmisin de la poltica monetaria citados se fortalecen. Esta mayor fortaleza permite que las acciones de la autoridad monetaria sean ms eficientes y logren llevar a la inflacin a su meta con un menor costo en trminos de actividad econmica. La eficaz conduccin de la poltica monetaria ha redundado en logros importantes en el abatimiento a la inflacin, en comparacin con los fenmenos observados hace dcadas. La inflacin ha disminuido de manera significativa no solo en su nivel, sino tambin en su volatilidad y persistencia, permitiendo mayores horizontes de planeacin para hogares y empresas. El anclaje de las expectativas de inflacin ha dado lugar a un abatimiento en las primas de riesgo, principalmente en la de riesgo inflacionario. Todo esto ha propiciado una disminucin en las tasas de inters nominales, lo que a su vez ha permitido un mayor crecimiento del crdito y de la inclusin financiera, incentivando la inversin y el crecimiento potencial de la economa. Cabe recordar que un entorno caracterizado por una inflacin alta y voltil desincentiva las decisiones de ahorro e inversin en la economa, por lo que los 5 beneficios que el mayor ahorro implica sobre la actividad econmica, se incrementan en la medida en que un ambiente de inflacin baja y estable faciliten la generacin de un ahorro an mayor. As, es en este punto que se cierra el crculo virtuoso que se produce gracias a las sinergias que han generado la reforma al sistema de pensiones y la autonoma del Banco de Mxico, con su consecuente impacto sobre el ahorro en nuestro pas. Es decir, el papel del SAR se complementa con, y se beneficia de, el fortalecimiento del marco institucional que se ha venido dando paralelamente en nuestro pas en los ltimos casi 25 aos, destacando la autonoma que obtuvo el Banco de Mxico en 1994 para el ejercicio de sus facultades. Al respecto, con base en su mandato constitucional, el Banco ha instrumentado una poltica monetaria orientada a la consecucin de una inflacin baja y estable, lo cual, como ya describ, incentiva un mayor ahorro del sector privado y permite que vuelva a comenzar el ciclo de ahorro-financiamiento-inversin-productividadcrecimiento-baja inflacin-ahorro. De esta forma, estos cambios institucionales, han dejado una huella indeleble en el robustecimiento del sistema financiero y en la capacidad de nuestra economa de absorber choques adversos. 6 Ahora bien, no obstante las importantes contribuciones al fortalecimiento del marco macroeconmico y al bienestar de los trabajadores mexicanos que han derivado de la reforma al SAR de 1997, el sistema pensionario en nuestro pas an enfrenta enormes desafos que hay que atacar por flancos mltiples y de forma coordinada. Uno de los ms relevantes es el de la ampliacin de la cobertura del SAR. Como sabemos, el rgimen de pensiones actual tiene una baja cobertura. Al primer trimestre de 2016, los cotizantes a la seguridad social en Mxico representaban apenas el 27 por ciento de la poblacin en edad de laborar, lo que ubica a nuestro pas por debajo de muchos pases como Chile (40%), Costa Rica (41%), Panam (47%), Uruguay (65%) segn datos de la Organizacin Internacional del Trabajo. Ello podra explicarse por muchos factores. El primero es de carcter estructural y se refiere al elevado grado de informalidad de la fuerza laboral de nuestro pas. En efecto, no obstante los importantes avances que se han observado en la dinmica del empleo formal en los ltimos cinco aos, en los que este tipo de trabajo ha crecido 1.8 veces ms que la economa en su conjunto, hoy por hoy de cada diez empleados, seis laboran en el sector informal. Un segundo factor podra estar 7 vinculado a la percepcin por parte de los trabajadores de que las comisiones son an elevadas, los rendimientos netos por peso ahorrado insuficientes, y los trmites complicados. Ello desestimula a los trabajadores a incorporarse tempranamente al sistema y permanecer en l. Relacionado con lo anterior, otro desafo relevante consiste en implementar polticas para incrementar el monto que reciben los trabajadores al momento de su jubilacin. Para ello es importante establecer medidas que se reflejen en mayores aportaciones a las cuentas de los trabajadores en las siefores, tanto en su componente obligatorio como en el voluntario. Ello no es tarea fcil. Por ejemplo, si bien establecer un aumento de las aportaciones obligatorias podra ser razonable, sobre todo considerando que las tasas de aportacin en Mxico son bajas en comparacin con las de otros pases, esta medida por s sola podra generar incentivos que favoreceran el empleo informal, erosionando la base de contribuyentes y futuros pensionados. Pero tampoco es tarea imposible. Se podra pensar en esquemas creativos como los que han fomentado economistas del comportamiento como Richard Thaler, el reciente ganador del Premio Nobel de Economa, al enrolar automticamente a los trabajadores para 8 contribuir a sus planes pensionarios, pre-estableciendo una proporcin del sueldo que se ahorra desde el momento que el empleado se incorpora a una empresa, aun cuando despus pueda l mismo disminuir esta proporcin. S, todava quedan retos importantes por delante. Pero estoy convencido de que con la voluntad y el compromiso de las instituciones, las autoridades y el sector patronal y sindical, que han venido trabajando de forma conjunta para el desarrollo y el progreso del SAR en las ltimas dcadas, se lograrn consensos y se implementarn las medidas necesarias en beneficio de los trabajadores y del pas en su conjunto. Termino felicitando a todos por contribuir, desde diversos frentes, a construir un mejor futuro para varias generaciones de mexicanos. Muchas gracias. 9

Title: Award ceremony of the sixth edition of the Banxico Challenge contest
text: Remarks by Mr. Alejandro Diaz de Leon, Governor of the Bank of Mexico, during the Award Ceremony of the Sixth Edition of the "BANXICO Challenge" Contest. Mexico City, May 27, 2021 Good evening, everyone. I hope you and your families are well. It is a pleasure to participate in this remote ceremony to celebrate the winners of this sixth edition of the "BANXICO Challenge" contest. Through its academic programs, outreach activities and research competitions, the Bank of Mexico has sought to strengthen contact with institutions and students in middle and higher education in the country. This segment of the population is key because of its growing influence in society and its next arrival in professional life. The "BANXICO Challenge" contest seeks to promote the interest of higher education students in issues that concern central banking. For the sixth edition of the "BANXICO Challenge", 215 teams were registered and 154 research papers were received, which is equivalent to 1 a total of 1,326 participants among students and advisors. Thus, historically, in the six editions of this contest more than 2 thousand teams have been registered, more than one thousand 300 works have been received and more than 9 thousand participants have been summoned among students and advisors. In addition, throughout these six editions, universities from all the federal entities of the country have participated. These figures are significant and demonstrate the enormous interest that this contest has generated among students, given the specialization of the subject, as well as the academic load involved in participating in it. In this way, the students have made their own the "BANXICO Challenge", in which you propose a monetary policy stance and defend it. In this task they have demonstrated their initiative and openness to intellectual challenges. You are instrumental in spreading the importance and social benefits that are obtained by maintaining the purchasing power of the national currency and promoting the proper functioning of the financial system and payment systems. 2 In this regard, a particular characteristic of central banks is their role as issuer of fiat money, that is, banknotes and coins, which constitute an indispensable instrument of economic progress. As fiat money has no intrinsic value, to fulfill its function requires that society has full confidence that it can be used as a means of payment at any time, that it serves as a safeguard of value and that it functions as a unit of account. When this does not happen, money ceases to fulfill its function in the economy. The issuance and circulation of fiat money must be done prudently and responsibly that is the fundamental role of monetary policy. For this, it is essential to be clear about its capabilities and limitations, since it has a clear influence on inflation, while it is ineffective by itself to influence real variables in the long term. Through their monetary policy, central banks control the terms and conditions under which money is provided to the economy. To decide the monetary policy stance, the central bank comprehensively assesses economic conditions, the external environment, the 3 internal and, in particular, the inflation forecasts that result from this. Based on these elements, the terms and conditions with which it supplies money to the economy are determined, that is, the interest rate. The conduct of monetary policy, within the framework of autonomy, has as its priority the stability of the purchasing power of the national currency. This institutional framework has made it possible to achieve a significant decrease in the level, volatility and persistence of inflation in recent decades. Since 2001 we can speak of a stationary process of inflation that implies that it is stable, low and predictable. This is the longest stage of price stability in the history of our country, which implies tangible benefits for the population. Dear contestants: Central banking must continue to provide society with public goods that contribute to economic growth and well-being. Notably, low and stable inflation and a financial and 4 Payments that work properly for society are essential to these outcomes. To meet these objectives, the task of economic research and analysis is indispensable. This improves the understanding of economics and contributes to finding more viable and pragmatic solutions, based on scientific and empirical evidence, to the unprecedented problems we face. Particularly those we have lived in the last year. Thanks to this event, the participants apply their talent and analytical skills to the dilemmas faced by central bankers. The result, so far, has been extraordinary. I congratulate the four finalist teams: one from the Mexico City campus, the Instituto Tecnologico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey; another from the Higher School of Economics of the National Polytechnic Institute and two from the Faculty of Economics of the National Autonomous University of Mexico. As usual in 5 This contest, the high level of many works put the jury in serious trouble. Again thank you to all the participants for their enthusiasm, dedication and work, and for making this enriching contest possible with their effort, especially in these complex and challenging circumstances. 6
text_original: Palabras del Lic. Alejandro Daz de Len, Gobernador del Banco de Mxico, durante la ceremonia de Premiacin de la Sexta Edicin del Concurso Reto BANXICO. Ciudad de Mxico, 27 de mayo de 2021 Muy buenas noches a todos. Espero que ustedes y sus familias se encuentren bien. Es un gusto participar en esta ceremonia a distancia para celebrar a los triunfadores de esta sexta edicin del concurso Reto BANXICO. Por medio de sus programas acadmicos, actividades de divulgacin y certmenes de investigacin, el Banco de Mxico ha buscado estrechar el contacto con las instituciones y los estudiantes de educacin media y superior del pas. Este segmento de la poblacin es clave por su creciente influencia en la sociedad y su prximo arribo a la vida profesional. El concurso Reto BANXICO busca promover el inters de los estudiantes de educacin superior en los temas que ataen a la banca central. Para la sexta edicin del Reto BANXICO se registraron 215 equipos y se recibieron 154 trabajos de investigacin, lo que equivale a 1 un total de 1,326 participantes entre estudiantes y asesores. As, histricamente, en las seis ediciones de este concurso se han registrado ms de 2 mil equipos, se han recibido ms de mil 300 trabajos y se ha convocado a ms de 9 mil participantes entre estudiantes y asesores. Adems, a lo largo de estas seis ediciones han participado universidades de todas las entidades federativas del pas. Estas cifras son significativas y demuestra el enorme inters que este certamen ha generado entre los estudiantes, dada la especializacin de la temtica, as como la carga acadmica que implica participar en l. De esta manera, los estudiantes han hecho suyo el Reto BANXICO, en el que ustedes plantean una postura de poltica monetaria y la defienden. En esta tarea han demostrado su iniciativa y apertura a los retos intelectuales. Ustedes son fundamentales para difundir la importancia y beneficios sociales que se obtienen al mantener el poder adquisitivo de la moneda nacional y promover el buen funcionamiento del sistema financiero y de los sistemas de pagos. 2 Al respecto, una caracterstica particular de los bancos centrales es su rol como emisor de dinero fiduciario, es decir los billetes y monedas, los cuales constituyen un instrumento indispensable del progreso econmico. Como el dinero fiduciario no tiene valor intrnseco, para cumplir su funcin requiere que la sociedad tenga plena confianza de que ste puede ser utilizado como medio de pago en cualquier momento, de que sirve como resguardo de valor y de que funciona como unidad de cuenta. Cuando ello no ocurre, el dinero deja de cumplir con su funcin en la economa. La emisin y circulacin de dinero fiduciario debe hacerse con prudencia y responsabilidad ese es el papel fundamental de la poltica monetaria. Para ello, es imprescindible tener claras su capacidades y limitaciones, ya que tiene influencia clara sobre la inflacin, mientras que es ineficaz por s misma para influir en variables reales en el largo plazo. A travs de su poltica monetaria los bancos centrales controlan los trminos y condiciones bajo las cuales se provee dinero a la economa. Para decidir la postura de poltica monetaria, el banco central evala de manera exhaustiva las condiciones econmicas, el entorno externo, el 3 interno y, en particular, los pronsticos de inflacin que resultan de esto. Con base en estos elementos se determinan los trminos y condiciones con los que suministra dinero a la economa, es decir la tasa de inters. La conduccin de la poltica monetaria, en el marco de autonoma, tiene como objeto prioritario la estabilidad del poder adquisitivo de la moneda nacional. Este marco institucional ha permitido lograr una disminucin importante en el nivel, volatilidad y persistencia de la inflacin en las ltimas dcadas. Desde el 2001 podemos hablar de un proceso estacionario de la inflacin que implica que sta sea estable, baja y predecible. Se trata de la etapa ms larga de estabilidad de precios en la historia de nuestro pas, lo que implica beneficios tangibles para la poblacin. Estimados concursantes: La banca central debe seguir brindando a la sociedad bienes pblicos que contribuyen al crecimiento econmico y al bienestar. De manera destacada, una inflacin baja y estable y un sistema financiero y de 4 pagos que funcionen adecuadamente para la sociedad son esenciales a estos resultados. Para cumplir con estos objetivos, la tarea de investigacin y anlisis econmico es indispensable. Esto mejora la comprensin de la economa y contribuye a encontrar soluciones ms viables y pragmticas, basadas en la evidencia cientfica y emprica, a los problemas inditos que enfrentamos. Particularmente los que hemos vivido en el ltimo ao. Gracias a este certamen, los participantes aplican su talento y capacidad de anlisis a los dilemas que ocupan a los responsables de la banca central. El resultado, hasta ahora, ha sido extraordinario. Felicito ampliamente a los cuatro equipos finalistas: uno proveniente del campus Ciudad de Mxico, del Instituto Tecnolgico y de Estudios Superiores de Monterrey; otro de la Escuela Superior de Economa del Instituto Politcnico Nacional y dos de la Facultad de Economa de la Universidad Nacional Autnoma de Mxico. Como ya es habitual en 5 este certamen, el alto nivel de muchos trabajos puso en serios aprietos al jurado. Nuevamente gracias a todos los participantes por su entusiasmo, dedicacin y trabajo, y por hacer posible este enriquecedor concurso con su esfuerzo, especialmente en estas circunstancias tan complejas y retadoras. 6

Title: Presentation of the National Financial Inclusion Policy
text: Remarks by Mr. Alejandro Diaz de Leon, Governor of the Bank of Mexico, during the presentation of the National Financial Inclusion Policy. Mexico City, March 11, 2020. Maestro Arturo Herrera, Secretary of Finance and Public Credit; Teacher Esteban Moctezuma, Secretary of Public Education; Maestro Gabriel Yorio, Undersecretary of Finance and Public Credit; Ladies and gentlemen: 1 It is an honor to participate in the presentation of this National Financial Inclusion Policy, in which lines of joint action are drawn up for the authorities of the sector. The presence of the Ministries of Finance and Education, as well as the Bank of the Bank of Mexico, reflects the coincidence that inclusion and financial education are parallel tasks that share the same goal: to empower the citizen. Indeed, the two pillars of financial inclusion that feed back are: on the one hand, expanding access to formal financial services and, on the other, providing the basic knowledge tools to take advantage of such access. An individual with access to the financial system and the tools to use it can better cope with an unexpected event, obtain more appropriate financing conditions for their productive activity, grow the fruit of their work or plan long-term goals such as the education of their children or their retirement from work. 2 On the other hand, the central objective of the financial system is to intermediate and channel financial resources towards the most productive projects, so greater inclusion favors the best use of the economy's resources. From the point of view of the central bank, this National Financial Inclusion Policy has important successes: 1. It offers a social conception of financial inclusion, which puts to the user in the center; 2. proposes a broad coordination of various authorities and the private sector, as the challenge of financial inclusion is multifaceted; 3. presents a comprehensive approach to the binomial inclusion and financial education; 4. recognises the unique opportunity that technology represents to close historical gaps; 5. assumes the need to develop deep payment networks on both the side of users and merchants; 6. identifies priority lines of action and establishes clear responsibilities, and 3 7. it sets specific goals that allow the coordination of the efforts of all the actors involved. At the Bank of Mexico, for several years, we have been working on the simultaneous objectives of inclusion and financial education. On the inclusion side, it has sought to improve competition, transparency and consumer protection in order to promote greater diversification of products with lower costs. Among the main actions in this regard are: 1. The establishment of basic deposit and payroll accounts without commissions; 2. the dissemination, by various means, of comparative information on commissions and costs of the financial products of the various intermediaries, and 3. greater mobility so that users can change their payroll and credit accounts. 4 Recently, the Digital Collection platform (CoDi) represents a significant step in payments in our country. Using the infrastructure of the Interbank Electronic Payments System, SPEI, operated by the Bank of Mexico, and with the use of QR and NFC technologies, the CoDi allows anyone who has a smartphone and opens a bank account, to make payments in seconds, 24 hours a day, free of charge and with high security standards. The CoDi implies for its users important benefits in terms of cost reduction and transparency. In addition, given that the universe of smartphone users almost doubles those who have financial instruments, the extension of this platform can encourage the use of other services and play a key role in financial inclusion for more than 30 million Mexicans. On the other hand, the Bank has been forming an important offer of financial education aimed at the most diverse audiences. Some of the relevant actions in the field are: 1. The publication of various educational materials for the public infant and primary school students. Highlights the book, "Money in 5 Mexico", whose contents were approved by the SEP. Based on this book, a course is currently taught to 33,000 students in 864 schools in the country; 2. for high school students, there are well-attended Awards such as "Contacto Banxico", which already reached its eleventh edition in 2019; 3. for the university segment the bank has 4 programs: "University Links"; "Banxico Challenge"; "Asignatura Banco de Mexico" and "Catedra Banxico", and 4. there is the portal "BANXICO educa" that disseminates information to all audiences, through innovative strategies and interactive technologies. Additionally, the Bank of Mexico promoted the first museum in the world specialized in economics, finance and sustainable development, the Interactive Museum of Economics (MIDE), which today welcomes us. In just under 15 years of existence, the MIDE has reached very diverse audiences, this year it will receive its visitor 3 million and has become an international reference that fills us with pride. 6 Ladies and gentlemen: Inclusion and financial education empower citizens and give them greater awareness of their potential, thus constituting a key factor for social mobility. This fosters a fairer society with greater opportunities for development. For all the above, the Bank of Mexico welcomes the comprehensive and pragmatic approach of this National Financial Inclusion Policy and we enthusiastically support its actions. Thanks a lot. 7

Title: Celebration of the sixtieth anniversary of the founding of the Mexican Institute of Finance Executives
text: Remarks by Mr. Alejandro Diaz de Leon, Governor of the Bank of Mexico, during the celebration of the Sixtieth Anniversary of the founding of the Mexican Institute of Finance Executives. Mexico City, September 21, 2021 Mtro. angel Garcia-Lascurain Valero, President of the National Board of Directors; Mtro. Gabriel Yorio Gonzalez, Undersecretary of Finance and Public Credit; Mr. Hector Guerrero Herrera, Undersecretary of Industry and Commerce; C.P. Alberto Aroeste Mayo, Founding Partner of IMEF; Presidents of trade union bodies; Ladies and gentlemen: 1 It is a pleasure and an honor to attend this celebration of the sixtieth anniversary of the Mexican Institute of Finance, which was founded on a day like today in 1961. I would like to congratulate all those who, with persistence and vision of the future, have managed to maintain and consolidate this exemplary organism for six decades. For me it is an enormous privilege to receive a distinction on this special date, and from an institute with such a history and prestige. Of course, in institutions such as the Bank of Mexico, those of us who occupy decision-making positions are only the visible face of a teamwork gear that includes many people. Therefore, I consider this distinction, which honors me so much, as a recognition of the work of all my colleagues at the Bank of Mexico who, with their technical capacity and daily dedication, contribute to serving the country achieving our constitutional and legal objectives. Therefore, on behalf of my colleagues on the Governing Board, and all the collaborators of the central bank, I thank and value this distinction. 2 Over the course of 60 years, the IMEF has convened the efforts and experience of the country's most important finance executives. In all this time, this organization has fulfilled various and valuable functions: it has been a space for the exchange of ideas and for updating and professional improvement for its members; he has also been a reference in research and opinion on economic and financial issues and, of course, has been a reliable and constructive interlocutor between the guild of finance executives and the various Mexican financial authorities. In particular, through its Research Foundation, the IMEF has actively participated in the generation of knowledge and informed opinion around financial management, business, accounting, administration and various economic issues. On the one hand, the IMEF-EY International Financial Research Award that the IMEF co-sponsors with Ernst & Young Global Limited, and which has three categories, is one of the most appreciated, both for the prestige that protects it and for the projection it generates in the academic and business community with a growing presence and 3 international recognition. It is an honor for the Bank of Mexico to be a member of the Jury of the Prize. In addition, the IMEF has promoted a significant editorial activity that has allowed the publication of volumes prepared by renowned specialists, with useful diagnoses on various economic issues. Likewise, he edits the Mexican Journal of Finance Executives, which is an instrument of dissemination not only for topics specialized in the activity of the guild, but for all economic agents. An undoubted merit of the IMEF has been to promote the creation of its own economic indicator, which, based on a 5-question survey, seeks to evaluate and infer the behavior of manufacturing and non-manufacturing activity in Mexico and, from there, anticipate the possible behavior of the economy. Due to its timeliness and quality, this indicator contributes to enriching the variety of indicators in our country. Another very important measure adopted by the IMEF, in February of this year, is the installation of the Committee for the Dating of the Cycles of the 4 Economy of Mexico, which is integrated by 7 experts in macroeconomic and statistical matters. This Committee has its origin in the work of a group of experts who established INEGI and CIDE in 2019, which determined the convenience of having an instance of this nature, in order to establish and keep updated a chronology of economic cycles in our country. The IMEF, with extraordinary disposition, decided to install, host and offer logistical support to this Committee, whose composition and professional recognition provides credibility, independence and neutrality. With all this, the IMEF provides valuable tools of information and analysis, as well as an informed opinion on the economic situation and prospects that has a significant influence on business decision-making. In short, this organization, in addition to being an instrument of updating and professional improvement for its members, throughout its history has undertaken tasks that have left an invaluable social footprint. Thus, the IMEF has been a catalyst for the 5 efforts of finance professionals in favor of the evolution of the guild and the development of the country. Although with different origins and vocations, the Bank of Mexico and the IMEF pursue permanent objectives and deploy a long-term vision of national development. As far as the Bank of Mexico is concerned, its foundation was the consummation of a long-cherished yearning for the country. From its beginnings as an independent nation, the issuance of fiat money was attempted and alternatives were sought to have a single issuer that would seek certainty in the provision of working capital and stability in the purchasing power of the currency. This was achieved in the Constitution of 1917 and with the founding of the Bank of Mexico in 1925. In its beginnings, the Bank of Mexico had to face various difficulties, such as the deep-rooted distrust of the population towards the use of fiat money. Since that time, but with greater clarity a 6 Once it was granted autonomy, it has concentrated all its efforts on consolidating the most valuable asset of any issuing institution, the credibility that it will invariably be conducted with the aim of preserving the purchasing power of the money it places among the public. In its origins the institution was able to provide currency to the economy and consolidate fiat money as a means of payment, and since its autonomy it has been able to better focus its efforts on maintaining the stability of the purchasing power of Mexican money. The autonomous conduct of monetary policy has been a determining element in achieving a significant decrease in the level, volatility and persistence of inflation in recent decades. Empirical evidence shows that, since 2001, we can speak of a stationary process of inflation, which has made it stable, low and predictable. This is the longest stage of price stability in the history of our country, which implies tangible benefits for the population and a firm basis for growth and development. 7 Price stability is essential to allow proper planning and operation of companies. Due to the nature of their activity, finance executives are directly aware of the distortions generated by inflationary episodes in the planning and execution of projects and, therefore, fully identify the benefits that an environment of price stability entails for economic activity. In fact, many of you probably witnessed or experienced firsthand, some decades ago, the uncertainty that inflation brings and its devastating effect on investment and employment, as well as on people's wealth and wages. Among the concrete benefits of the decline in inflation in Mexico is the downward trend in interest rates, which has contributed to greater access for companies and individuals to credit with lower costs and longer terms. For example, in 1995, the longest term of federal government funding at a fixed rate was 6 months and, since 2003, it reaches up to 30 years. This extension of the yield curve has enabled long-term fixed-rate financing. 8 with notable benefits both for the productive investment of companies and for the mortgage credit of households. Another example of the positive effects of pursuing price stability is the reduced response of inflation to shocks, such as a depreciation of the national currency, which used to have a severe impact on prices. In the last century, episodes of pronounced exchange rate depreciation and volatile inflationary processes with double-digit levels were common. The consolidation of low and stable inflation has allowed an orderly adjustment in the financial markets and in the economy. This has been evident in the face of the shocks of the global crisis of 2008 and 2009, the challenges to NAFTA that began in 2016 or the pandemic that we have recently faced. Thus, it has been possible to overcome episodes of considerable turbulence with less impact on the real economy and its effect on inflation and on the income and wealth of Mexicans, particularly those with lower incomes, has been mitigated, avoiding greater poverty and inequality. 9 Currently, the environment for inflation is complex. After a deep and sudden economic contraction in 2020, global economic activity is recovering, at a heterogeneous pace between sectors and countries. Around the world, supply chains have been affected, particularly those of the most complex and widespread production processes. In addition, in the most advanced economies, substantial incentives have been adopted for the expansion of spending. This has accentuated production bottlenecks and led to global inflationary pressures. In this circumstance, the Bank of Mexico has sought to conduct monetary policy in a timely and prudent manner, promoting an orderly adjustment both in the financial markets and in the economy as a whole, and avoiding risks of contamination in price formation in the face of recent inflationary pressures. The Bank also adopted a number of unprecedented but necessary measures to promote the sound development of the financial system and the proper functioning of payment systems. In this way, in the 10 Its scope of possibilities and purposes, has contributed to mitigate the adverse effects of the pandemic on Mexican families. Ladies and gentlemen, we are a few days away from the bicentennial celebration of the consummation of the Independence of Mexico. This historical event represents an example that, when the different actors put aside our differences and come together around the same goal, we can achieve transcendental achievements and goals that would seem unthinkable. Today, we are summoned to celebrate the IMEF that has managed to become an exemplary institution thanks to a set of visions and aspirations shared among the guild of finance executives. This unity has allowed them to make solid contributions to their members and to society in general. Similarly, the Bank of Mexico reflects how, thanks to great agreements and national consensus, it has been possible to build a solid constitutional and legal basis to have an institution. 11 fully committed to its priority objective of providing the country with national currency and maintaining its purchasing power. To this is also added the promotion of the healthy development of the financial system and the proper functioning of the payment system. These three mandates make it possible to consolidate public goods that are fundamental to the well-being of individuals and families, as well as to promote a more solid and balanced economic development. Within the framework of the celebrations of these days, this occasion is more than propitious to highlight the importance of the generation of agreements and institutions that seek the best balance between the individual interest and the common good, as the IMEF highlights. Thank you very much again for this recognition that I receive on behalf of the entire central bank team and, of course, many, many congratulations for these 60 years of fruitful work. Congratulations. 12
